item.title: Elon Musk agrees to settle lawsuits over 2024 election lottery
item.description: Elon Musk and his America PAC political action committee said on Thursday they agreed to settle two proposed class actions alleging the billionaire entrepreneur defrauded residents in closely contested states before the 2024 US election by promising voters a lottery-style daily $1 million giveaway.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Elon Musk and his America PAC political action committee said on Thursday they agreed to settle two proposed class actions alleging the billionaire entrepreneur defrauded residents in closely contested states before the [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"2024 US election"] by promising voters a lottery-style daily $1 million giveaway. Here are the details: The plaintiffs, Musk and America PAC told the judge overseeing the two related lawsuits in federal court in Austin, Texas, that they have reached settlements subject to court approval The filings did not include settlement terms, and lawyers involved in the case declined to comment or did not respond to requests for more information The plaintiffs in the two cases are Arizona residents who said Musk and America PAC [USN:L1N3UC0YA TEXT:"misled voters"] in seven swing states into signing his petition to support the US Constitution by promising $1 million daily to randomly selected signatories The defendants denied the allegations Musk founded America PAC to support Republican Donald Trump's successful 2024 presidential run A federal judge in June said [USN:L6N42X16V TEXT:"Musk must testify"] in the lawsuits

item.title: Ventaja de Flavio Bolsonaro sobre Lula se reduce de cara a segunda vuelta en Brasil: sondeo Datafolha
item.description: El senador Flavio Bolsonaro sigue por delante del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva de cara a la segunda vuelta electoral del 25 de octubre en Brasil, aunque la diferencia se ha reducido, reveló el jueves una encuesta de Datafolha.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El senador Flavio Bolsonaro sigue por delante del presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva de cara a la segunda vuelta electoral del 25 de octubre en Brasil, aunque la diferencia se ha reducido, reveló el jueves una encuesta de Datafolha. El hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro obtendría el 47% de los votos frente al 45% del presidente, según la encuesta. Un sondeo de Datafolha de la semana pasada mostraba a Bolsonaro por delante de Lula con un 49% frente a un 45% de las preferencias.

item.title: Shooter killed at Oregon elementary school; CNN, CBS report four dead in violence
item.description: A person with a gun opened fire on Thursday at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, wounding multiple victims, including children, before the assailant was killed, possibly by an armed onlooker, according to police.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Trotta, Steve Gorman
item.content:encoded: A person with a gun opened fire on Thursday at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, wounding multiple victims, including children, before the assailant was killed, possibly by an armed onlooker, according to police. CNN and CBS News, citing law enforcement sources, reported that one adult and three children were killed in the violence, but it was not immediately clear whether the shooter was included in that death toll. CBS News later reported the shooter was 16 years old. Police in Bend, a city of about 100,000 residents in rural central Oregon, 175 miles (280 km) southeast of Portland, said the first call they received from the 1 p.m. (2000 GMT) incident "indicated that an unknown man had shot into a car" at Silver Rail Elementary School. Police officers arriving seconds later found that the suspect had been shot dead, possibly by a bystander, police said in a statement. Sheila Miller, a spokesperson for the Bend Police Department, told reporters investigators had yet to confirm who shot the suspect. Miller told reporters that at least two victims were transported to a hospital but she was unaware of their condition. The subsequent police statement, posted online, said authorities "have confirmed there were multiple victims," with at least two taken to hospital, adding, "Children are among the victims." Silver Rail Elementary School serves kindergarten through fifth grade, roughly ages 5 to 11, in Bend, situated in the Oregon high desert adjacent to the Deschutes National Forest. It has about 450 students and 40 staff members, Miller said. US Representative Maxine Dexter, a physician who represents a portion of Portland east of the Willamette River, called the shooting a "devastating day for Oregon." "Schools should be places of learning, friendship and joy. It is incumbent on me, and every lawmaker, to do everything we can to ensure our kids are safe," she said in a statement. "As we learn more about the tragic event at Silver Rail Elementary in Bend today, we must come together and support each other, neighbor to neighbor, Oregonian to Oregonian. No community should have to live through this day," Governor Tina Kotek said separately on X. FBI chief Kash Patel said on X that federal agents were on the scene "assisting our local partners in the investigation" and that his agency would "make every resource they need available."

item.title: North Korea says opening ceremony was held for new bridge to China
item.description: North Korea's state media KCNA said on Friday that an opening ceremony was held for the Amnok River bridge linking to China, which is also called New Yalu River Bridge.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: North Korea's state media KCNA said on Friday that an opening ceremony was held for the Amnok River bridge linking to China, which is also called New Yalu River Bridge. The bridge will "accelerate the advance for the prosperity of the two countries and the well-being of the peoples and add fresh vigour to the equally beneficial economic cooperation," Pak Thae Song, premier of the North Korean cabinet, said at the ceremony through video conferencing, according to KCNA. Chinese Premier Li Qiang, also in a video speech, said China would remain unchanged in its "firm attitude to highly prioritize the China-DPRK friendship no matter how the international situation may change," referring to the official name of the North Korean state. Li also expressed his willingness to expand practical cooperation and deepen political interests between the two countries, according to KCNA. The two leaders did not elaborate on details of the purpose for the bridge. China's Xinhua News Agency [USN:L1N46103M TEXT:"reported"] on Thursday that the two countries officially opened the bridge, which links the Chinese city of Dandong with North Korea.

item.title: Vantagem de Flávio sobre Lula diminui para 47% a 45%, mostra Datafolha
item.description: A vantagem do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) sobre o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) diminuiu no segundo turno da disputa pelo Planalto, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira, ainda que as variações registradas estejam dentro da margem de erro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A vantagem do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) sobre o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) diminuiu no segundo turno da disputa pelo Planalto, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira, ainda que as variações registradas estejam dentro da margem de erro. Flávio tem 47% das intenções de voto, enquanto Lula soma 45%, segundo o levantamento. Na semana passada, o placar estava em 49% a 45% a favor do senador. Como a margem de erro da pesquisa é de 2 pontos percentuais, os dois candidatos continuam em situação de empate técnico. Os indecisos somam 2% (eram 1% na pesquisa anterior), enquanto aqueles que dizem que votarão em branco, anularão o voto ou não votarão em nenhum candidato chegam a 6% (eram 5%). Em votos válidos, quando não são considerados os votos brancos e nulos e os indecisos, Flávio tem 51% contra 49% de Lula. Na semana passada, o placar era 52% a 48%. Flávio venceu o primeiro turno da disputa pelo Planalto no início do mês com 47,03% dos votos válidos, contra 45,16% de Lula. O segundo turno será realizado no próximo dia 25. O levantamento desta quinta é o primeiro do Datafolha após manifestações de apoio a Lula em várias cidades do país, a maior delas em São Paulo no último domingo, com a presença do próprio presidente. Ainda assim, os números não mostraram crescimento da sua candidatura nas intenções de voto. Já Flávio registrou uma desidratação dentro da margem de erro que parece ter ido para os indecisos e votos brancos e nulos. O Datafolha também apontou que a rejeição do presidente se manteve em 46%, enquanto a rejeição do senador oscilou para 44%, ante 43% na semana passada. A pesquisa mostrou ainda que 50% desaprovam o governo (ante 49%), enquanto a parcela dos que aprovam se manteve em 48%. Já a avaliação do governo é ruim/péssima para 41% (era 40%), continua ótima/boa para 35% e está regular para 23% (ante 24%). O Datafolha ouviu 2.520 pessoas entre terça e quarta-feira.

item.title: Itaú invierte 1.780 millones de reales en Eneva III
item.description: Eneva anunció el jueves que Itaú Unibanco firmó un acuerdo para invertir 1.780 millones de reales en la filial Eneva III Participações, mediante la suscripción de nuevas acciones preferentes con derecho a voto restringido.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Eneva (ENEV3.SA) anunció el jueves que Itaú Unibanco firmó un acuerdo para invertir 1.780 millones de reales en la filial Eneva III Participações, mediante la suscripción de nuevas acciones preferentes con derecho a voto restringido. "Itaú ha ampliado su participación en el capital social total de Eneva III, manteniéndose como titular de la totalidad de las acciones preferentes emitidas por Eneva III, mientras que la empresa (Eneva) se ha mantenido como titular de la totalidad de las acciones ordinarias de Eneva III", afirmó el grupo energético. El acuerdo prevé una opción de compra por parte de Eneva de la totalidad de las acciones preferentes de Eneva III en poder de Itaú Unibanco. El ejercicio de dicha opción podrá tener lugar entre 2031 y finales de 2032, pudiendo adelantarse "en determinadas circunstancias".

item.title: Lonnie Walker IV to play in Turkey
item.description: After being waived by the Denver Nuggets earlier this week, Lonnie Walker IV signed with Besiktas in Turkey and the EuroLeague on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: After being waived by the Denver Nuggets earlier this week, Lonnie Walker IV signed with Besiktas in Turkey and the EuroLeague on Thursday. Walker had signed a one-year non-guaranteed contract with Denver in August. He appeared in two preseason games for the Nuggets, scoring four points in 17 total minutes of playing time. But Denver waived him on Oct. 12. Walker was a first-round draft selection (18th overall) of the San Antonio Spurs in 2018. He played for the Spurs from 2018-22 and averaged 12.1 points per game in 70 contests in 2021-22. The Philadelphia native earned a one-year, $6.5 million contract with the Los Angeles Lakers and averaged 11.7 points per game in 2022-23. He played for the Brooklyn Nets the following season, and, after a stint with Zalgiris Kaunas of the Lithuanian Basketball League, Walker played for in 20 games for his hometown Philadelphia 76ers in 2025. Walker averaged 12.4 points per game for Philadelphia and scored a career-high 31 points in his last NBA game on April 13, 2025 against the Chicago Bulls. He signed a two-year contract with Maccabi Tel Aviv of the Israeli Basketball Premier League and the EuroLeague in the summer of 2025 and elected to use the opt-out clause to sign with the Nuggets. --Field Level Media

item.title: Hammack dice que deterioro de expectativas inflación podría requerir una respuesta de la Fed
item.description: La presidenta del Banco de la Reserva Federal de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmó el jueves que, si se produjera un deterioro de las expectativas de inflación del público, probablemente sería necesario que el banco central adoptara medidas más agresivas para contrarrestarlo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La presidenta del Banco de la Reserva Federal de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmó el jueves que, si se produjera un deterioro de las expectativas de inflación del público, probablemente sería necesario que el banco central adoptara medidas más agresivas para contrarrestarlo. "Lo que me preocupa es que, si se instala esta mentalidad inflacionaria, si se generan expectativas de que estas presiones sobre los precios se vuelvan cada vez más persistentes, resultará mucho más difícil que la política monetaria cumpla con su cometido, y podría ser necesario tomar medidas aún más drásticas que si no existiera esa mentalidad", afirmó.

item.title: Juegos "dispersos" serán cada vez más habituales, dice directora ejecutiva de Comité Olímpico EEUU
item.description: Los Juegos con sedes geográficamente dispersas están en camino de convertirse en la norma, afirmó el jueves la directora ejecutiva del Comité Olímpico de Estados Unidos (USOPC), Sarah Hirshland, ya que la creciente envergadura de las citas complica los planes de infraestructura de los países anfitriones.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Los Juegos con sedes geográficamente dispersas están en camino de convertirse en la norma, afirmó el jueves la directora ejecutiva del Comité Olímpico de Estados Unidos (USOPC), Sarah Hirshland, ya que la creciente envergadura de las citas complica los planes de infraestructura de los países anfitriones. Los responsables del COI calificaron de éxito los Juegos de Milán-Cortina, a pesar de las preocupaciones iniciales sobre los primeros Olímpicos de Invierno cuyas sedes se extendían a lo largo de 22.000 kilómetros. También se prevé que los próximos Juegos de Los Ángeles 2028 se celebren de forma dispersa, ya que el sóftbol y el piragüismo en eslalon tendrán lugar en Oklahoma City, mientras que el fútbol se disputará en varias áreas metropolitanas: Nueva York, Columbus, Nashville, Saint Louis, San José y San Diego. "La distribución de los propios Juegos está evolucionando. Y gran parte de ello se debe a que la envergadura de los Juegos se ha vuelto tan grande y significativa que resulta muy difícil encontrar en un solo lugar la infraestructura necesaria para acogerlos", afirmó Hirshland. Se espera que los Juegos de 2030 en los Alpes franceses sigan el modelo de Milán-Cortina, con sedes en Niza y las regiones alpinas. El estado de Nueva York ha creado este año un comité exploratorio para acoger los Juegos de Invierno de 2042, cuyas disciplinas se repartirán entre cinco distritos y Lake Placid. En comparación, el plan centralizado para las sedes de Utah 2034 constituirá una excepción, señaló Hirshland. "Es probable que los Juegos de Los Ángeles 2028 sean los Juegos de verano más grandes de la historia", afirmó. "Mi impresión es que los Juegos de verano que se celebren a partir de entonces probablemente serán más modestos que los de Los Ángeles". "Y gran parte de ello se debe a la demanda de infraestructura, a los costos y, en cierta medida, llega un punto en el que incluso la logística se vuelve tan engorrosa que no se puede seguir creciendo a menos que se replantee realmente la forma de hacerlo", remarcó.

item.title: Report: Rockies dismiss pitching coach Alon Leichman
item.description: The Colorado Rockies fired pitching coach Alon Leichman after one season, The Athletic reported Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Colorado Rockies fired pitching coach Alon Leichman after one season, The Athletic reported Thursday. The Rockies allowed a league-worst 944 runs last season and also had the worst staff ERA (5.59) in the majors. Colorado went 58-104 and lost over 100 games for the fourth straight season. The Rockies served up the third-most homers (227) in the majors and the most hits (1,635). The .288 opponents' batting average also was worst in the majors. Leichman, a 37-year-old Israeli, previously served as assistant pitching coach for the Cincinnati Reds (2023-24) and Miami Marlins (2025). Leichman pitched college baseball for UC San Diego (2015-16). In 2021, he pitched for Israel in the Tokyo Olympics. Darryl Scott was Colorado's pitching coach from 2022-25 before the hiring of Leichman. The team ERA was actually improved from 2025, when it nearly reached six runs allowed per nine innings (5.97). The Rockies have finished last in the team ERA for five consecutive years. --Field Level Media

item.title: Bolsonaro's lead over Lula narrows ahead of Brazil runoff, Datafolha poll shows
item.description: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro continues to slightly lead President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva heading to the October 25 election runoff, but the gap has narrowed, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro continues to slightly lead President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva heading to the October 25 election runoff, but the gap has narrowed, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday. The senator, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, would receive 47% of the vote compared with 45% for the president, according to the poll. Last week, a Datafolha poll showed the younger Bolsonaro leading Lula 49% to 45%. The poll's result still represents a technical tie as the margin of error is plus or minus 2 percentage points 6% of the respondents said they would cast a blank vote, and undecided voters made up 2%, the poll showed In valid votes, which exclude blank votes and undecided voters, Bolsonaro leads Lula 51% to 49% Datafolha surveyed 2,520 people between October 13-14 The younger Bolsonaro [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"surprisingly led"] Lula in the first-round vote earlier this month

item.title: Bears QB Caleb Williams confirms torn hamstring; tests remain before return
item.description: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams was a full participant in practice Thursday, his first consecutive practices since a Week 2 hamstring injury sent him to the sideline.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams was a full participant in practice Thursday, his first consecutive practices since a Week 2 hamstring injury sent him to the sideline. Williams confirmed for the first time Thursday he was dealing with a torn hamstring and isn't out of the woods entirely as optimism grows he could be back in the starting lineup against the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday. But Williams, who wore a sleeve on his right leg in his first full on-field practice Thursday since he was injured, is definitely making a push to play. "This is a big week. I've been going through cutting and planting over the past couple weeks and it's felt good, you've seen me moving around on Fridays and before games," Williams said. "But it's different when you have to go through a full week of practice, prepare for a game, and take on that stress on the mind, body, and spirit. We'll see how it goes." The Bears are one of three 3-2 teams in the NFC North in pursuit of the undefeated Vikings (5-0). The team got a good look at his progress in Thursday's practice. Head coach Ben Johnson listed Williams as a full participant on Wednesday, but the workout was a walkthrough and participation is an approximation. Williams said he's extremely confident in his health and his style of play won't change if he receives medical clearance to face the Falcons. "I can move, I can run, I hit top speed the other day. One of the highest speeds I've ever hit," Williams said. To put in mildly, Williams was perturbed discussing reports about the severity of his hamstring injury and his use of a cart to reach the locker room. Williams declined to state the severity -- or grade -- of his hamstring tear other than to say it was a "pretty serious one." "I care about this team, this organization, winning, and being out there with my teammates," Williams said. "Not being able to play was frustrating, and that's where the emotion came from. All the noise and false reports from people outside the building don't bother me, if you didn't hear it straight from me or the organization, it isn't true. We'll be back out there soon and ready to roll." --Field Level Media

item.title: Fed's Hammack warns inflation expectations deterioration could require Fed response
item.description: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said on Thursday the Fed might need to hike interest rates more aggressively if there were to be a notable deterioration in the public’s inflation expectations.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said on Thursday the Fed might need to hike interest rates more aggressively if there were to be a notable deterioration in the public’s inflation expectations. “What I worry about is, if you get this inflationary mindset, if you get these expectations that these price pressures become more and more persistent, it makes it much harder for monetary policy to do the work that we need to do, and we might need to move even more than if you don't have an inflationary mindset set in,” Hammack said at an event held by Goldman Sachs in New York. Hammack did not give firm guidance about what the current situation means for monetary policy, but the official, who holds a role on the rate-setting Federal Open Market Committee, has been a strong and early supporter of the central bank countering high inflation pressures with rate rises. The Fed raised its interest rate target by a quarter percentage point to between 3.75% and 4% last month and is widely expected to raise rates again by the end of the year. Inflation data released this week showed worse-than-expected price pressures, which caused some market watchers to increase the odds that the Fed might raise rates at the FOMC meeting on October 27-28. Hammack’s comments on Thursday were among the last public remarks scheduled by central bankers ahead of the quiet period that precedes the month-end meeting. Markets are closely watching a speech scheduled for late Thursday by Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh to see if he offers any monetary policy clues. Hammack also said in her appearance that financial conditions seem roughly neutral right now amid investments in things like technology that are going full speed ahead despite rising borrowing costs. “I'm not feeling that there's restraint coming from financial conditions at this…point in time,” the official said.

item.title: US FDA takes step to change peptide compounding policy
item.description: The US FDA on Thursday submitted a new policy change that could allow pharmacies to more easily compound certain peptides to the White House for consideration.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US FDA on Thursday submitted a new policy change that could allow pharmacies to more easily compound certain peptides to the White House for consideration. Telehealth company Hims & Hers Health (HIMS.N) had previously said it [USN:L6N43F18B TEXT:"plans to offer"] peptides if regulations permit. Advisers had [USN:L6N43Q0TI TEXT:"recommended the US Food and Drug Administration"] loosen restrictions on six of seven peptides under review in July, including the popular BPC-157. Peptides — used for everything from pain to muscle recovery to beauty — have been promoted by social media influencers and Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. They are drugs built from short chains of amino acids, the same building blocks the body uses to make proteins. The ones under consideration have not been approved by the FDA as safe or effective. Compounding pharmacies are allowed to mix ingredients of approved drugs in specialized doses and other under circumstances. The Department of Health and Human Services and the FDA submitted an "interim access policy for compounding using certain peptides" for White House review, according to a filing on the Office of Management and Budget's website. The filing does not provide any details of the policy. The Associated Press, citing two people familiar with the matter, said that it would allow them to make some popular peptides, including BPC-157, which is also known as Wolverine. Despite not being approved by the FDA, [USN:L1N4570VF TEXT:"its use is soaring"]. Hims & Hers and the Department of Health and Human Services, which oversees the FDA, did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment. An administration official declined to comment.

item.title: Chip startup Bolt Graphics seeking to raise $100 million at about a $700 million valuation, sources say
item.description: Chip-design startup Bolt Graphics is seeking to raise roughly $100 million at a valuation of about $700 million as part of an effort to make a graphics chip to compete with Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices , according to three people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Max Cherney
item.content:encoded: Chip-design startup Bolt Graphics is seeking to raise roughly $100 million at a valuation of about $700 million as part of an effort to make a graphics chip to compete with Nvidia (NVDA.O) and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) , according to three people familiar with the matter. The thirst for AI computing and the financial frenzy surrounding it poured billions of dollars of profit into the likes of Nvidia and AMD, which have in turn focused their efforts on improving the underlying hardware. Bolt is seeking to design chips that will focus on non-AI areas such as the high-precision calculations supercomputers perform and graphics for videogames. The fundraising effort is ongoing and the amount of capital and valuation Bolt is seeking could change, the people said. Reuters could not learn which investors were leading the funding round. The funding could test whether investors have the appetite to back chip startups that plan to tackle problems outside of the AI-focused products that Nvidia and AMD have poured billions of dollars into developing. Bolt CEO Darwesh Singh declined to comment on the funding round or terms but said the fundraising is "well under way." The Silicon Valley-based startup is initially targeting fewer applications and plans to focus on professional markets such as 3D artists and game developers first and then expand into gaming graphics processing units, or GPUs, in the future. Making a videogame chip can be complex because of the amount of software needed to support the thousands of titles that any new hardware should support. ZEUS CHIP TARGETS SCIENTIFIC COMPUTING This week, Bolt completed the first round of testing for its Zeus GPU architecture that it is aiming to design for physics simulation. The company plans to produce the final chip on Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co's (2330.TW) process. Bolt is designing the Zeus chip for scientific computing, chip design and professional rendering — which includes some tasks that require higher-precision calculations known as FP64. Over the last 10 years, venture capital firms have been reluctant to back chip startups because of large costs associated with producing a cutting-edge chip and the length of time it takes to jump start a business. Bolt has been working on its chips and hardware for roughly six years. AI investments have captured an enormous amount of attention this year so far, especially in the chip industry. Investors put about $10.7 billion into semiconductor startups in the first five months of 2026, on a pace to exceed the $12.2 billion raised globally in all of 2025, according to Crunchbase data.

item.title: Lula anuncia PEC para zerar tarifa do transporte coletivo nos finais de semana
item.description: O presidente e candidato à reeleição Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) anunciou nesta quinta-feira que vai enviar ao Congresso uma Proposta de Emenda à Constituição (PEC) para zerar a tarifa do transporte coletivo urbano nos finais de semana e feriados a partir de 2027, caso vença a eleição deste mês.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente e candidato à reeleição Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) anunciou nesta quinta-feira que vai enviar ao Congresso uma Proposta de Emenda à Constituição (PEC) para zerar a tarifa do transporte coletivo urbano nos finais de semana e feriados a partir de 2027, caso vença a eleição deste mês. "Vou enviar ao Congresso Nacional uma PEC para garantir passe livre nos finais de semana em todas as cidades brasileiras que tenham transporte coletivo. Porque o trabalhador e a trabalhadora merecem mais do que tempo para descansar", publicou Lula no X. Mais cedo, o jornal O Estado de S. Paulo afirmou que Lula iria anunciar um programa de tarifa zero no transporte de ônibus urbanos aos finais de semana e feriados a partir de 2027, caso vença a disputa com o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) no segundo turno da corrida pelo Planalto.

item.title: Vegas bettor pleads guilty to game-fixing, point-shaving schemes
item.description: A Las Vegas-based sports bettor, who was indicted in three high-profile federal gambling cases, pleaded guilty to multiple charges related to betting schemes on Wednesday in federal court in Philadelphia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Las Vegas-based sports bettor, who was indicted in three high-profile federal gambling cases, pleaded guilty to multiple charges related to betting schemes on Wednesday in federal court in Philadelphia. Shane Hennen's indictments concerned point-shaving and game-fixing schemes for NBA, NCAA and Chinese Basketball Association games between 2022 and 2025. He pleaded guilty to bribery in sporting contests, conspiracy to commit wire fraud and three counts of wire fraud in the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. "The defendant engaged in the scheme as a ‘fixer,' working together with others who recruited and bribed CBA and NCAA men's basketball players to underperform and help ensure their team failed to cover the spread," federal prosecutors said in court documents. "The defendant then placed large wagers on those games, and arranged for others to do so, generating proceeds for the scheme." Hennen also pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and money laundering as part of a separate case in the Eastern District of New York. That case, which involves former NBA player Terry Rozier, is related to a scheme to utilize nonpublic information to bet on NBA games and players. Hennen's sentencing hearing is set for Feb. 25, 2027, in Philadelphia. He could receive a maximum sentence of 125 years in prison -- up to 85 years in the Pennsylvania case and up to 40 years in the New York case. He previously pleaded guilty in a third case, which concerned allegedly rigged poker games involving the Mafia. Chauncey Billups, the Hall of Famer and former Portland Trail Blazers coach, and former NBA player and coach Damon Jones have also been indicted in this case. Jones has pleaded guilty. Hennen is slated to be sentenced in New York in January in connection with the poker case. --Field Level Media

item.title: Meta releases open-weight Muse Spark model for coding, agentic tasks
item.description: Meta Platforms on Thursday released an open-weight version of its Muse Spark artificial intelligence model for coding and AI agents, expanding developers' ability to download and adapt the technology.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms (META.O) on Thursday released an open-weight version of its Muse Spark artificial intelligence model for coding and AI agents, expanding developers' ability to download and adapt the technology. Open-weight models make trained parameters available for developers to modify, unlike proprietary models that remain under their creators' control. They can offer businesses a lower-cost alternative to closed systems. Meta said Muse Spark has 816 billion total parameters, with 42 billion active at a time, and can handle a context window of up to 1 million tokens The model can run locally on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studio computers and is also available through some API providers CEO Mark Zuckerberg has argued that advanced AI should not be concentrated among a small number of companies While open-weight models can give companies greater control over their data, they can require significant computing resources and technical expertise to operate at scale In August, Meta had released Muse Glimmer, a smaller open-weight model

item.title: MSCI weighs downgrading Indonesia to standalone-market status
item.description: MSCI said on Friday it was considering downgrading Indonesia to standalone- from emerging-market status, citing persistent concerns about the investability and governance of the country's equity market.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: MSCI (MSCI.N) said on Friday it was considering downgrading Indonesia to standalone- from emerging-market status, citing persistent concerns about the investability and governance of the country's equity market. The index provider launched a consultation on the proposed downgrade after issuing a [USN:L1N42V0SW TEXT:"warning in June"] that Indonesia could face reclassification if concerns about market accessibility persisted. MSCI said investors had raised concerns about opaque ownership structures, concentrated shareholdings and suspected coordinated trading, which it said undermined the market's investability. Indonesian authorities have since announced reforms, including enhanced shareholder disclosure requirements and a roadmap for a minimum free-float requirement of 15%. However, MSCI said market participants had yet to see consistent evidence that the measures had materially improved market functioning. "Accordingly, MSCI considers Indonesia’s continued classification as an Emerging Market no longer appropriate and is launching a consultation on a proposal to reclassify Indonesia as a Standalone Market," MSCI said. The consultation will run until April 30, 2027, with a final decision due by June 30. MSCI said investor feedback suggested a move to frontier-market status would not adequately reflect Indonesia's market-accessibility issues. It expects to proceed with the proposed standalone classification unless there is clear evidence of material improvements in governance and market functioning. MSCI will also maintain a freeze on certain index-related changes for Indonesian securities until further notice, including additions to the MSCI Indonesia Investable Market Index and increases in foreign inclusion factors or shares outstanding resulting from index reviews or corporate events. Indonesia has faced a series of setbacks this year, with [USN:L4N3Z114D TEXT:"Moody's"] and [USN:L1N3ZS06T TEXT:"Fitch"] cutting their sovereign rating outlooks to negative, citing reduced policymaking credibility. The benchmark Jakarta stock index (.JKSE) has fallen more than 30% this year, making it the worst-performing equity market in emerging Asia.

item.title: Sensational Cisse powers Milan to victory as Leverkusen thump Lech Poznan
item.description: Teenager Alphadjo Cisse became the youngest Italian to score a hat-trick in European club competition as he helped AC Milan to a thumping 4-0 victory over Austrian hosts RB Salzburg in the Europa League on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Nick Said
item.content:encoded: Teenager Alphadjo Cisse became the youngest Italian to score a hat-trick in European club competition as he helped AC Milan to a thumping 4-0 victory over Austrian hosts RB Salzburg in the Europa League on Thursday. Cisse's treble is also the first by a Milan player in a continental fixture since Filippo Inzaghi 24 years ago as the Italians overcame an opening-round home loss to Benfica to claim an emphatic away win, despite finishing the game with 10 men. The 19-year-old scored all his goals inside 49 minutes to underline the faith shown in him by coach Ruben Amorim. "He owes me nothing," Amorim said. "He deserves the playing time he's getting because of what he's doing. He knows how to be explosive. He has a lot of heart, but he can still improve in training and in matches. "Tonight he deserves all the praise, but there are things he needs to work on, and he has enormous potential." Milan lost Filippo Terracciano to a straight red card late in the game for a professional foul. Bayer Leverkusen made it two wins from two as they thumped Lech Poznan 4-0 in Poland with a pair of Patrik Schick penalties helping them along the way. Olympique Lyonnais edged Crystal Palace 3-2 in a battle between two clubs who were previously both controlled by American businessman John Textor. Both teams qualified for the competition last season, but Palace were demoted to the Conference League as a result of Textor’s shareholding, which was perhaps a blessing in disguise as they went on to win that competition. Pavel Sulc scored Lyon’s third goal to put them 3-1 up, but Palace battled back as Daichi Kamada’s goal eight minutes from the end set up a nervous finish for the home side. The Brazilian pair of Evanilson and Rayan were among the goals as Bournemouth eased to a 3-0 home win over Sturm Graz of Austria in their first-ever home European tie, while Sunderland came from behind to secure a 2-1 win at Portuguese side Torreense with Noah Sadiki netting the winner in the 93rd minute. The English duo are two of 10 teams with a full haul of six points from the opening two rounds. Benfica thumped Scottish side Celtic 4-1 with Jhon Duran scoring a brace, while Randal Kolo Muani netted a late winner as Juventus edged Celta Vigo 2-1 in Spain to top the standings. Olympique de Marseille’s poor start to their European campaign continued as they remain pointless following a 1-0 home loss to Olympiacos Piraeus. In the Conference League, there were wins for AS Monaco at CSKA Sofia and a thumping 4-0 success for Brighton & Hove Albion over Lithuanian side Kauno Zalgiris, but Dutch side Ajax Amsterdam slipped to a surprise 2-1 loss at Hajduk Split.

item.title: 米英国防相、ウクライナでのスターリンク復旧を歓迎 中断理由には踏み込まず
item.description:
[ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - 英国のストリーティング国防相は、ヘグセス米国防長官と１５日に会談し、ウクライナにおける衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の復旧を歓迎したと述べた。ただ、中断が発生した理由については踏み込まなかったとした。
ストリーティング氏はヘグセス氏との会談後、米ＦＯＸニュースの番組に出演。米国防総省はロシアのエネルギー施設への攻撃を防ぐ目的でウクライナの攻撃・防衛能力を制限したのかとの質問に対し、「私の理解ではそうではない。サービス中断がなぜ起きたのかについては、実際には踏み込まなかった。サービスが復旧した事実について簡単に言及し、それを歓迎した」と述べた。
また、サービス中断の理由について推測するつもりはないと述べた。
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - 英国のストリーティング国防相は、ヘグセス米国防長官と１５日に会談し、ウクライナにおける衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の復旧を歓迎したと述べた。ただ、中断が発生した理由については踏み込まなかったとした。

ストリーティング氏はヘグセス氏との会談後、米ＦＯＸニュースの番組に出演。米国防総省はロシアのエネルギー施設への攻撃を防ぐ目的でウクライナの攻撃・防衛能力を制限したのかとの質問に対し、「私の理解ではそうではない。サービス中断がなぜ起きたのかについては、実際には踏み込まなかった。サービスが復旧した事実について簡単に言及し、それを歓迎した」と述べた。

また、サービス中断の理由について推測するつもりはないと述べた。

ウクライナは１４日、イーロン・マスク氏が最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を務める米宇宙開発企業スペースＸが、スターリンクのサービスを制限し、ウクライナの攻撃用および防空用ドローン作戦に支障が出たと述べた。

これに対しマスク氏は、同システムの通信速度は米政府が管理していると述べた。

item.title: Grande manifestação universitária contra Milei termina em confrontos na Argentina
item.description: Um grande protesto de argentinos contra as medidas de austeridade do presidente ultraliberal Javier Milei na área da educação terminou nesta quinta-feira em confrontos com a polícia em frente ao Congresso Nacional.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um grande protesto de argentinos contra as medidas de austeridade do presidente ultraliberal Javier Milei na área da educação terminou nesta quinta-feira em confrontos com a polícia em frente ao Congresso Nacional. Os manifestantes, em sua maioria estudantes, professores e cidadãos independentes, exigiam que o presidente cumprisse uma lei aprovada pelo Congresso para reverter o corte no orçamento universitário, que o governo tem ignorado apesar de várias decisões judiciais contra ele. O protesto reflete o profundo descontentamento de grande parte da classe média argentina com os cortes que o presidente aplicou na economia — especialmente em setores sensíveis como educação e saúde — para reduzir a inflação. Esse descontentamento se reflete na baixa popularidade de Milei, constatada pela maioria das pesquisas de opinião. Autoridades da Universidade de Buenos Aires (UBA), que conta com mais de 300 mil estudantes e vários prêmios Nobel ao longo de sua história, estimaram que seu corpo docente perdeu cerca de 30% de seu salário sob a gestão da direita radical. “Não vamos normalizar o descumprimento da lei. As leis devem ser cumpridas. Sempre”, publicou a UBA nas redes sociais para convocar o protesto que ocorria em frente ao Congresso Nacional. Com enormes bandeiras e faixas em defesa da educação pública, a manifestação, que reuniu uma multidão, paralisou o centro da cidade. Mas, antes do ato principal, ocorreram confrontos entre a polícia e um grupo minoritário situado entre os manifestantes, em frente ao Congresso, em Buenos Aires, que resultaram em feridos e anteciparam o fim do protesto. “Nossa reivindicação é pelo financiamento, pelo orçamento universitário que o governo não cumpre há mais de 350 dias. Vamos continuar lutando pela universidade pública, gratuita e de qualidade”, disse à Reuters Juan Sgró, professor da Faculdade de Artes da Universidade Nacional de Córdoba. O protesto se repetiu em outras cidades importantes do país, como Rosário e Córdoba.

ORLANDO, Florida, Oct 15 : The AI equity rout accelerated significantly in Asia on Thursday on growing fears about the murky, circular financing powering the intelligence revolution's buildout, although its force evaporated in European and US trading hours. Still, safe-haven inflows meant US Treasuries had one of their best days in months, despite a surprisingly strong rise in US producer inflation. • AI investment boom may be papering over US economic cracks: Mike Dolan • US producer prices post largest gain in 4-1/2 years; expensive gasoline boosts retail sales • Warsh's quest for quiet Fed gets vocal pushback • Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: Asia in the red, South Korea -7.5 per cent to 6-month low, Japan -5 per cent. UK +1 per cent to 7-week high. Nasdaq +0.1 per cent, S&P 500 +0.3 per cent, Dow +1 per cent.SECTORS/SHARES: Eight sectors on the S&P 500 rise, three fall. Tech -0.5 per cent, energy -1.5 per cent, healthcare +2 per cent. CoreWeave +6.5 per cent, Nike +5 per cent. Hewlett Packard, Dell -7 per cent.FX: Dollar slides, biggest fall in six weeks. Biggest gainer is Swiss franc, +1 per cent; biggest decliner is Brazilian real, -1.5 per cent.BONDS: Bund yield -11 bps to 3.35 per cent, lowest in over a month. US 10-year yield -10 bps to 5.08 per cent, curve flattens. CoreWeave and other AI corporate bonds rise.COMMODITIES/METALS: Oil mixed — Brent flat, WTI +3 per cent. Gold +1 per cent, silver +3 per cent. Today's Talking Points: Funny money The global AI trade has hit some major turbulence. South Korea's KOSPI, a top 10 global index, has lost 20 per cent of its value in barely a week, and on Thursday Japan's Nikkei slid 5 per cent. CoreWeave 2032 bonds issued just four months ago fell below 80 cents in the dollar, typically considered distressed debt levels, and the cost of insuring against major US AI firms defaulting has soared to record levels. As ever, credit markets are likely to lead equities, and the risk of a self-fulfilling doom loop cannot be ignored — selling in certain names casts a shadow over healthier credits, and downgrades and loss of investment-grade ratings could force further selling. All while cash has been spent, and capex is increasingly being financed by debt, private credit and off-balance-sheet borrowing. We're not at crisis point yet — look at the rebound in US stocks and bonds today — but vigilance is required. Bonds be bonds Incoming data shows US producer price inflation is running hotter than expected, like CPI the day before, WTI crude spikes another 3 per cent, and Treasuries rally. Sounds counterintuitive, especially given how heavily fixed income markets have traded in recent weeks, but it shows that the demise of Treasuries' safe-haven appeal has been greatly exaggerated. Thursday was one of the best days of the year for Treasuries, especially for maturities of 10 years and beyond. The question is whether this is a knee-jerk move, or will continued volatility in equities and weakness in AI-related corporate debt remind investors that the best place to hedge, diversify and protect their capital is the traditional "risk-free" asset? Guaranteed nominal yields of over 5 per cent appear to be tempting. Rotation, rotation, rotation Wall Street's resilience on Thursday was pretty remarkable, given the ferocity of the tech selloff in Asia and weight of negative sentiment at the session open. Chip stocks fell for a seventh day, their longest losing streak in four years, but the Nasdaq edged higher and, more impressively, the Dow rose 1 per cent to its highest in a month. As the US earnings season kicks into gear, the focus will be on tech. The bar of expectations is high, and if it is not hurdled, investors may decide to ramp up the rotation into other sectors. How long do rotations out of tech last? According to Deutsche Bank, since mid-2024 the average length of rotation is 67 days and the median is 59 days. In terms of tech drawdowns over these periods, the average is 16.6 per cent and the median is 14.6 per cent. What could move markets tomorrow? • IMF/World Bank meetings in Bangkok, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, ECB President Christine Lagarde, and BoE Governor Andrew Bailey among several officials speaking • Euro zone trade (August) • Euro zone inflation (September, final) • US import prices (September) • US industrial production (September) Want to receive Trading Day in your inbox every weekday morning? item.title: Investors temper Anthropic IPO valuation expectations over revenue growth slowdown, sources say
item.description: Some current Anthropic investors and prospective investors in its upcoming initial public offering are weighing a lower valuation for the AI company after its latest financial disclosures, four people familiar with the matter said, amid broader concerns over the ballooning cost of financing AI.
item.dc:creator: Milana Vinn, Anirban Sen
item.content:encoded: Some current Anthropic investors and prospective investors in its upcoming initial public offering are weighing a lower valuation for the AI company after its latest financial disclosures, four people familiar with the matter said, amid broader concerns over the ballooning cost of financing AI. Some investors who attended [USN:L6N4601AA TEXT:"Anthropic's investor day"] on Wednesday in San Francisco discussed a valuation of around $1.5 trillion, three of the people said, a significant step down from the roughly $2 trillion valuation that investors had previously expected for the November share sale. At Wednesday's meeting, Anthropic told prospective IPO investors that its third-quarter revenue jumped 45% to $16.8 billion from the previous quarter, and that it was profitable on an adjusted basis during the quarter. While those numbers assuaged some concerns about the massive costs of developing AI systems, some investors were disappointed by the slowing sequential growth rate in the latest quarter, as Anthropic's revenue more than doubled from the first quarter to $11.6 billion in the second quarter, the people added. They spoke on condition of anonymity because they are not authorized to speak publicly on the matter. Anthropic did not immediately respond to requests for comment. A cooler reception for Anthropic's IPO could weigh on the wider AI market, whose near-term prospects investors see as hinging largely on the share sale's success, followed by [USN:L6N45407M TEXT:"OpenAI's potential listing"] next year. BELLWETHER IPO The concerns from investors come as a tech selloff is roiling global financial markets and has hurt AI infrastructure companies, chipmakers and so-called neocloud providers that rent computing power for AI broadly. Shares and bonds of Nvidia (NVDA.O) -backed CoreWeave (CRWV.O) [USN:L4N46111C TEXT:" tumbled on Thursday"], reflecting growing investor concern about an AI buildout that is increasingly being financed with borrowed money. A disappointing share sale for Anthropic could further add to investor worries about the AI buildout. The IPO market has suffered [USN:L6N45H0SG TEXT:"some setbacks"] recently, after data center operator SB Energy decided to delay its listing last month, while nuclear technology company Holtec Nuclear [USN:L4N4581N0 TEXT:"pulled its plans to go public"]. During Wednesday's meeting at Anthropic's headquarters in San Francisco, attendees, mostly the company's most prominent investors, met with CEO Dario Amodei and finance chief Krishna Rao. The Information earlier reported that investors were considering a lower valuation. Founded in 2021 by former OpenAI executives including Amodei and his sister Daniela Amodei, who is now Anthropic's president, Anthropic has emerged as one of the leading generative AI developers with its Claude family of models. The company's rapid growth has been underpinned by Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google and Amazon (AMZN.O) , which are simultaneously investors, suppliers of computing power and important distribution partners, as well as AI competitors. Last year, Anthropic's revenue surged twelvefold to nearly $4.6 billion, even as the company lost more than $8 billion on an operating basis, excluding writedowns of various liabilities mostly tied to previous fundraising, Reuters [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"reported "]last month. In its IPO prospectus seen exclusively by Reuters in September, Anthropic laid out a vision that AI will transform the global economy more profoundly than industrialization, electricity and the internet, even as it reported a loss of $42 billion in 2025 and projected more spending for the upcoming AI buildout. The company has committed to spending [USN:L1N45K0RM TEXT:"at least $518 billion"] over a decade for cloud services, computing and infrastructure.

item.title: Vídeo de suposto uso de drogas é anterior a ato pró-Lula na Paulista
item.description: Um vídeo em que uma mulher de cabelos vermelhos supostamente usa drogas circula nas redes sociais desde junho deste ano, mas posts associam a imagem ao ato em apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva no último domingo em São Paulo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo em que uma mulher de cabelos vermelhos supostamente usa drogas circula nas redes sociais desde junho deste ano, mas posts associam a imagem ao ato em apoio ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva no último domingo em São Paulo. Estes são os principais detalhes: “Manifestação petista” e “petistas na avenida Paulista”, diz uma publicação com as imagens no Instagram . No domingo, apoiadores de Lula se reuniram na avenida Paulista, em São Paulo. Já o vídeo compartilhado nas publicações checadas, em que uma mulher leva um cartão até o nariz, aparece em posts no X desde 6 de junho , mais de quatro meses antes do ato pró-Lula. A Reuters também localizou outros posts com as imagens no Facebook e no Instagram nos dias 7 e 8 daquele mês. As publicações têm um enunciado que diz "un ejemplazo los pibes ricoteros" -- "um baita exemplo, os moleques ricoteiros", em livre tradução para o português. O termo “ricoteiros” é usado para se referir aos fãs da banda argentina Patricio Rey y sus Redonditos de Ricota . O vocalista da banda, Carlos Alberto “Indio” Solari, morreu aos 77 anos no dia 5 de junho. Sua morte gerou grande comoção na Argentina, provocando manifestações nas ruas , e uma multidão foi ao seu velório . Veredicto: Legenda errada. Imagens de uma mulher supostamente usando drogas são anteriores ao ato pró-Lula do último domingo em São Paulo, e são atribuídas a manifestações na Argentina. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、ＡＩ関連企業への懸念が重し 10月利上げ観測後退
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １５日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。連邦準備...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、ＡＩ関連企業への懸念が重し　10月利上げ観測後退 5:53 配信

２０１１年１月撮影　REUTERS/Kacper Pempel

［ニューヨーク　１５日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者の慎重な発言を受け１０月の利上げ観測が後退しているほか、この日発表された堅調な物価・消費関連指標よりもＡＩ（人工知能）向けデータセンター関連企業を巡る懸念に市場の関心が集まったことがドルの重しになった。

この日発表の米経済指標では、９月の小売売上高が前月比０．８％増加。ガソリン価格の上昇を背景に予想を上回る伸びとなったが、ガソリン以外の支出は総じて緩やかで、自動車、ガソリン、建設資材、外食サービスを除くコア小売売上高は前月比０．１％増と、伸びは前月から鈍化した。

９月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ、最終需要向け財・サービス）は前年比６．３％上昇。２０２２年１２月以来の大幅な伸びとなり、エネルギー関連以外にもインフレが広がっている可能性が改めて示された。

マネックスＵＳＡのトレーディング部門責任者、フアン・ペレス氏は「現在のインフレ率とその上昇ペースは持続不可能との見方から、ドルに弱気な相場観が広がっている」と指摘。「景気停滞を巡る懸念が市場心理に大きく影響する中、この４週間の大幅なドル高を受けて市場はドル売りに傾いている」と述べた。

前日に発表された９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前年比は３．７％上昇と、伸びは前月の３．４％から加速。予想の３．６％も上回った。これを受け、当初はＦＲＢは追加利上げに動くとの見方が強まったものの、その後、ボウマンＦＲＢ副議長やサンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁が判断材料を見極める時間的余裕があるとの認識を示したことで、利上げ観測は後退した。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが２７─２８日の会合で金利据え置きを決定する確率は７３％。１カ月前の５３％から上昇した。

ロンドンのＬＭＡＸグループで市場ストラテジストを務めるジョエル・クルーガー氏は、ＡＩ関連企業の多額の債務負担への懸念が再燃したことで安全資産とされる米国債に資金が流入していることに関連し、「国債利回りの上昇が続かず、ドル相場の上昇局面で売りが続く場合、インフレ関連の材料はおおむね市場に織り込まれたとの見方が強まる。その場合、リスク資産に有利な方向に市場のリスクバランスが傾く」と述べた。

市場ではＦＲＢの金融政策の行方を見極めようと、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が１６日にバンコクで開かれる国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）・世界銀行年次総会で行う講演が注目されている。

メシロー・カレンシー・マネジメントのシニア投資戦略担当者、ウト・シノハラ氏は「ＦＲＢはまもなく（ＦＯＭＣ前後に金融政策に関する発言を控える）ブラックアウト期間に入る上、ＦＯＭＣまでに重要な経済指標の発表は残されていない」とし、「このため、市場の方向性は引き続きロシア・ウクライナ情勢やイランを巡る地政学的な不透明感に加え、ＡＩを巡る動向に左右される可能性が高い」としている。

終盤の取引で主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．４５％安の１０１．９９。前日は１年６カ月ぶりの高値を付けていた。

ユーロは対ドルで０．５６％高の１．１２１８ドル。円は対ドルで０．１５％高の１５８．０８円。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 157.98/158.00

始値 157.75

高値 158.24

安値 157.56

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1218/1.1222

始値 1.1213

item.title: Dispersed Games to become increasingly common, says USOPC CEO Hirshland
item.description: Geographically dispersed Games are well on their way to becoming the norm, USOPC CEO Sarah Hirshland said on Thursday, as the growing scale of the Olympics complicates infrastructure plans for hosts.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: Geographically dispersed Games are well on their way to becoming the norm, USOPC CEO Sarah Hirshland said on Thursday, as the growing scale of the Olympics complicates infrastructure plans for hosts. IOC officials hailed the most recent Milano Cortina Games as a success, despite early concerns over the [USN:L6N3ZG0S7 TEXT:"first spread-out"] Winter Olympics that had venues scattered over [USN:L6N3Z10RY TEXT:"22,000 kilometres"]. The upcoming LA28 Games are also expected to be spread out, with softball and canoe slalom set to take place in [USN:L1N3W10KK TEXT:"Oklahoma City"] and soccer to be in several [USN:KBN3OT2CX TEXT:"metropolitan areas"]: New York City; Columbus, Ohio; Nashville, Tennessee; St. Louis; San Jose, California; and San Diego. "The disbursement of the Games themselves is evolving. And a lot of that is because the scale of the Games has gotten so big and significant that the infrastructure required to host is very hard to find in a single place," said Hirshland, who was speaking from the Columbia University Sports Management Conference. The 2030 Games in the French Alps [USN:L6N3ZH02Z TEXT:"are expected"] to follow the Milano Cortina model, with venues in Nice and the Alpine regions. New York state [USN:L6N42U0XE TEXT:"this year"] formed an exploratory committee to host the 2042 Winter Games, with the duties to be shared between the five boroughs and Lake Placid. By comparison, the centralised plan for Utah 2034's venues will serve as a "rare exception," said Hirshland. "It is likely that the LA 2028 Games will be the largest summer Games ever," she said. "My guess is that the summer Games thereon after will probably be smaller than what we're going to see in LA. And a lot of that is infrastructure demand, cost demand, and to some degree there is a point at which even the logistics get so cumbersome that you can't continue to grow unless you really rethink the way you do it."

item.title: Meta diz ao TSE que trabalha no aperfeiçoamento de ferramenta de IA nas eleições
item.description: Representantes da Meta disseram nesta quinta-feira ao Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) que estão trabalhando no aperfeiçoamento de filtros da Meta AI, o assistente de inteligência artificial desenvolvido pela companhia dona das redes sociais Instagram, WhatsApp e Facebook, informou a corte eleitoral após reunião entre as partes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Representantes da Meta disseram nesta quinta-feira ao Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) que estão trabalhando no aperfeiçoamento de filtros da Meta AI, o assistente de inteligência artificial desenvolvido pela companhia dona das redes sociais Instagram, WhatsApp e Facebook, informou a corte eleitoral após reunião entre as partes. Segundo comunicado divulgado pelo TSE, o presidente e o vice-presidente do tribunal, Kassio Nunes Marques e André Mendonça, reuniram-se com representantes da Meta (META.O) "para debater as ferramentas utilizadas pela empresa que podem contribuir para o período eleitoral brasileiro". O encontro ocorreu um dia após a campanha à reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) [USN:L1N46013H TEXT:"recorrer"] ao TSE e até a Organização dos Estados Americanos (OEA) acusando a big tech de usar inteligência artificial e algoritmos para favorecer o adversário no segundo turno da eleição presidencial, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). O TSE disse, no comunicado desta quinta-feira, que a preocupação é promover uma “paridade de armas” entre os candidatos para que o eleitor possa escolher livremente. "Segundo a empresa (Meta), nesta semana, as duas campanhas foram impactadas pela geração de conteúdos de inteligência artificial considerados inadequados", disse o TSE em comunicado. Procurada, a Meta respondeu que no comunicado divulgado pelo TSE estão todas as informações disponíveis. Os ministros do TSE, conforme a nota, mencionaram também o tema do uso dos canais de WhatsApp para promover conteúdo eleitoral. "A Meta informou que, de acordo com a política da empresa, as mensagens enviadas nos canais não são criptografadas", disse a empresa, segundo o TSE. De acordo o TSE, a Meta se comprometeu ainda a empenhar os esforços necessários para vedar eventuais impulsionamentos de conteúdos de propaganda eleitoral feitos com moeda estrangeira.

item.title: 仏大統領、ウクライナに「あらゆる手段の提供重要」 ゼレンスキー氏と会談
item.description: [ブリュッセル １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ブリュッセル １５日 ロイター] - マクロン仏大統領は１５日、ブリュッセルでウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と会談後、同国の民間人とインフラを守るために必要なあらゆる手段を提供することが極めて重要であるとの考えを示した。

ゼレンスキー氏は通信アプリ「テレグラム」に、マクロン氏との会談は「非常に的を射た内容だった」と投稿。ロシアのエスカレーションへの対応策を見い出すために「可能な限り支援してくれている」として、フランスを高く評価していると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、フランスは今後１カ月間でウクライナの航空分野への支援を一段と拡大する予定であり、両国は欧州各国と進める弾道ミサイル迎撃システム「フレイヤ」計画の作業を加速させることに強い意欲を示したという。

item.title: Dream, Valkyries each have 3 All-Defensive honorees
item.description: They say defense wins championships, and the two teams headed to the WNBA Finals, the Atlanta Dream and Golden State Valkyries, led the league with three All-Defensive selections apiece on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: They say defense wins championships, and the two teams headed to the WNBA Finals, the Atlanta Dream and Golden State Valkyries, led the league with three All-Defensive selections apiece on Thursday. Atlanta saw forward Angel Reese -- the Defensive Player of the Year -- and guard Rhyne Howard named to the All-Defensive first team and guard Jordin Canada recognized on the second team. For Golden State, forward Gabby Williams was honored on the first team and guard Veronica Burton and center Kiah Stokes were named to the second team. Five-time league MVP A'ja Wilson (Las Vegas) and center Shakira Austin (Washington) comprised the rest of the first team. The other second-team selections were guard Sonia Citron (Washington) and two-time MVP Breanna Stewart (New York). Reese, in her first season with the Dream, led the league with 12.1 rebounds per game. She finished third in the league in steals per game (1.8) and set a career high with 32 blocked shots. Meanwhile, her teammates Howard and Canada were the only players to rank above her in steals, topping the list at 2.3 and 1.9 per game, respectively. Howard's 99 steals tie for second all-time behind Hall of Famer Teresa Weatherspoon, who had 100 in 30 games in 1998. Williams and Burton each averaged 1.6 steals, and Stokes totaled 74 blocks, second in the league only to Wilson (79). The second-seeded Valkyries and fourth-seeded Dream will tip off the best-of-seven WNBA Finals on Saturday in San Francisco. --Field Level Media

item.title: Choque de micro-ônibus com trem em terminal do Túnel do Canal da Mancha, na França, deixa 19 feridos
item.description: Pelo menos 19 pessoas ficaram feridas na noite desta quinta-feira após um micro-ônibus colidir com um trem em uma plataforma de embarque do Túnel do Canal da Mancha, no norte da França, informou a prefeitura local.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pelo menos 19 pessoas ficaram feridas na noite desta quinta-feira após um micro-ônibus colidir com um trem em uma plataforma de embarque do Túnel do Canal da Mancha, no norte da França, informou a prefeitura local. Nenhum dos feridos corria risco de vida, informou a prefeitura em comunicado, acrescentando que ambulâncias, um helicóptero e a polícia estavam no local. O acidente envolveu um micro-ônibus que transportava motoristas de caminhão que se preparavam para embarcar no serviço Le Shuttle na plataforma de embarque nas instalações do Eurotúnel, informou a prefeitura em comunicado posterior. O micro-ônibus colidiu com um trem que estava prestes a partir, informou a prefeitura.

item.title: Peso mexicano recupera terreno tras datos EEUU, bolsa cierra con ganancias
item.description: El peso mexicano avanzó el jueves, tras dos jornadas de pérdidas, después de que cifras económicas de Estados Unidos reforzaron las apuestas de que la Reserva Federal mantendrá sin cambios las tasas de interés en su próxima reunión.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El peso mexicano avanzó el jueves, tras dos jornadas de pérdidas, después de que cifras económicas de Estados Unidos reforzaron las apuestas de que la Reserva Federal mantendrá sin cambios las tasas de interés en su próxima reunión. * La moneda local cotizaba en 18.4148 unidades por dólar en la recta final de los negocios, con una apreciación del 0.35%, revirtiendo las pérdidas que había registrado [USN:L1N46000G TEXT:"por la mañana"]. * El cambio de rumbo se produjo a medida que el [USN:L1N4610Q9 TEXT:"dólar estadounidense"] cedió terreno desde un máximo de 18 meses y los rendimientos de los [USN:L6N4611AU TEXT:"bonos del Tesoro"] a más largo plazo cayeron a sus niveles más bajos desde septiembre. * "Para la jornada de mañana, espero que el tipo de cambio cotice dentro de un rango proyectado de consolidación técnica entre los 18.30 y 18.52 pesos por dólar", dijo Felipe Mendoza, analista de mercados de la firma EBC Financial Group. * Las [USN:L6N4610WU TEXT:"ventas minoristas"] de Estados Unidos crecieron en septiembre más de lo esperado, mientras que las solicitudes semanales de [USN:L6N4610X3 TEXT:"subsidio por desempleo"] aumentaron ligeramente. Otro informe mostró que los [USN:L6N4610YR TEXT:"precios al productor"] registraron el mes pasado su mayor avance en cuatro años y medio. * Tras la publicación de los datos, operadores elevaron sus apuestas a que la Reserva Federal dejaría sin cambios las tasas de interés en su próxima reunión, prevista para el 27 y 28 de octubre. Sin embargo, anticipan que reanudaría las alzas hacia finales de año, tras el [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"ajuste de septiembre"]. * El mercado bursátil también cerró el día con ganancias, retomando el tono positivo que ha predominado en las últimas sesiones, de la mano de una recuperación de [USN:L6N4611C5 TEXT:"Wall Street"]. * El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) subió un 1.31% a 67,663.29 puntos, luego de haber caído el miércoles por un ajuste tras cuatro jornadas consecutivas de ganancias. * Los títulos del conglomerado Grupo Carso (GCARSOA1.MX) encabezaron el repunte, con un 8.71% más a 157.76 pesos, seguidos por los de la cementera Cemex (CEMEXCPO.MX) , que sumaron un 5.10% a 18.56 pesos. * En el mercado secundario de deuda, el rendimiento del bono gubernamental a 10 años descendió un punto base a un 9.25%, mientras que la tasa a 20 años cerró estable en un 9.71%.

item.title: アンソロピック、外部評価機関ＭＥＴＲに社員並みアクセス ＡＩ安全性強化へ
item.description:
Aditya Soni
[１５日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業のアンソロピックは１５日、ＡＩの安全性を...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック、外部評価機関ＭＥＴＲに社員並みアクセス　ＡＩ安全性強化へ 5:36 配信

米カリフォルニア州サンフランシスコで開催されたDreamforce 2026テクノロジーサミットで９月撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria

Aditya Soni

[１５日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業のアンソロピックは１５日、ＡＩの安全性を研究する非営利団体ＭＥＴＲに、自社システムへの社員レベルのアクセス権を付与したと明らかにした。ＡＩ新興企業ハギングフェイス など他の組織とも協議中という。ＡＩ各社は、技術開発のペースを遅らせることなく安全性を高める手段として、外部評価機関の活用を打ち出している。

アンソロピックはブログで、生物安全保障分野の非営利団体「セキュアバイオ」や、コンサルティング大手アクセンチュアのＡＩ事業部門ファカルティーも評価機関として起用していると説明した。

アンソロピックによると、ＭＥＴＲの職員６人には、同社のハードウエア、オフィススペースのほか、社内のリスク評価チームとほぼ同等の内部システムへのアクセス権が与えられる。ただし、顧客データ、法的機密情報、モデルのアーキテクチャーについてはアクセス対象外となる。

アンソロピックは、セキュアバイオやファカルティーなど他の評価機関との提携は初期段階にあり、アクセス権や公表権は限定的だと述べた。

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro não foi ao Senado para sessão sobre 6x1, mas votou à distância
item.description: O senador e candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) participou de forma remota da sessão em que foi aprovado o fim da escala 6x1, nesta quarta-feira, votando à distância a favor da proposta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: O senador e candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) participou de forma remota da sessão em que foi aprovado o fim da escala 6x1, nesta quarta-feira, votando à distância a favor da proposta. "Adivinha quem não foi nem presencial, nem online, na votação pra acabar com a escala 6x1?", dizem posts no Facebook e no Instagram. “Flávio arregou!!! Depois de prometer que ia votar pelo fim da escala 6x1, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro faltou à sessão que vota o projeto”, completam. Flávio estava em Porto Alegre nesta quarta-feira para um evento de campanha, mas votou remotamente a favor da proposta de emenda à Constituição (PEC) que prevê o fim da escala 6x1. O texto foi aprovado pelo Senado, e o candidato não fez nenhum pronunciamento durante a sessão. Embora tenha criticado a PEC durante a corrida eleitoral, Flávio anunciou à imprensa na véspera da votação que seria favorável à proposta por ser a vontade da “maioria dos trabalhadores”. Ele também declarou que o governo federal terá de pagar uma compensação aos empresários pelo fim da escala 6x1. Flávio vinha defendendo a remuneração proporcional à hora trabalhada. Segundo o jornal O Globo, líderes do PL no Congresso Nacional disseram que o senador pretende insistir na proposta se eleito presidente. VEREDICTO Sem contexto. Flávio Bolsonaro votou remotamente a favor da PEC pelo fim da escala 6x1. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check.
