item.title: フーシ派、サウジの空港など数十カ所に攻撃試みる 戦闘激化＝サウジ連合軍
item.description: [リヤド １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[リヤド １５日 ロイター] - イエメンのサウジアラビア主導の有志連合軍は１５日、親イラン武装組織フーシ派とサウジの戦闘が激化する中、フーシ派が今月に入り、サウジの空港、港湾、石油施設数十カ所に対する攻撃を試みたと発表した。

連合軍のトゥルキ・マリキ報道官は記者会見で、フーシ派は今月、サウジの首都リヤドのキング・ハーリド国際空港に対して２０回の攻撃を行い、１７人が死亡、３３３人が負傷したと述べた。同空港はサウジ有数の国際航空ハブで、民間インフラの中で一連の攻撃の標的になっていると連合軍は述べている。

連合軍はまた、イエメン国境に近いサウジ南西部のアブハ空港へのフーシ派の攻撃により、３人が死亡、２８人が負傷したと述べた。

マリキ氏は、フーシ派が弾道ミサイル、ドローン、爆発物を搭載した高速艇など、高度な軍事技術を「地域の勢力」の支援を受けて入手したと指摘。一方、連合軍がイエメンの山岳地帯にある１２７カ所の武器貯蔵施設と発射装置を破壊したことも明らかにした。

その上で、フーシ派に対し、民間人や民間インフラを標的とした作戦を直ちに停止するよう要求。フーシ派は連合軍の声明を注意深く「行間を読んで」理解すべきだと述べた。

連合軍の声明発表後、フーシ派の軍報道官は、サウジの領空と空港は安全ではないと表明し、航空会社への警告を改めて示した。ただし、聖地メッカとメディナ上空の空域は除外するとした。

item.title: プーチン氏、ウクライナによる製油所攻撃に報復表明＝インタファクス通信
item.description: [モスクワ １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ １５日 ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は１５日、ウクライナによるロシア国内の石油精製施設への攻撃に対し報復すると表明した。インタファクス通信が報じた。

プーチン氏は、ウクライナによる攻撃で特に重大な被害は出ていないとしている。

ウクライナはこの日、ロシア国内の製油所を攻撃。これに先立ちウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、トランプ米大統領が発表したエネルギー施設への攻撃停止について、ロシアが順守していないとして、ウクライナも応じるのは「終わりだ」と表明していた。

item.title: OpenAI, Meta caution US judiciary about risk of 'deepfake' evidence
item.description: Tech experts at OpenAI and Meta Platforms warned a federal judicial panel on Thursday that AI-generated "deepfakes" are becoming so sophisticated that it will become increasingly challenging to determine the authenticity of audio and video evidence presented at trial.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: Tech experts at OpenAI and Meta Platforms (META.O) warned a federal judicial panel on Thursday that AI-generated "deepfakes" are becoming so sophisticated that it will become increasingly challenging to determine the authenticity of audio and video evidence presented at trial. The companies' representatives and other experts shared their views on the evolving technology during a meeting in Boston of the US Judicial Conference's Advisory Committee on Evidence Rules, which for three years has grappled with how to police the risks of fabricated AI-generated evidence in court. In that period alone, rapid advancements in generative AI have reached the point where fabricated videos have become difficult for both humans and software to spot, experts advised at the meeting. "AI images are only getting better, and I do not think that there will be a scientific way going forward to detect them," OpenAI policy counsel Shira Anderson told the committee. The panel has [USN:L1N41K1BT TEXT:"struggled since 2023"] with how to address authentication issues related to deepfakes and ensure that evidence known to be generated by AI meets the same reliability standards as evidence from a human expert witness. The judiciary has sought to get ahead of the issue despite a lack of evidence that it is a widespread problem. The Federal Judiciary Center, the judiciary's research arm, in March said that out of 931 judges who responded to a survey, only 15 had encountered a case in which a litigant challenged the introduction of evidence because it was a deepfake. "There's a lot of academic commentary and other commentary predicting that courts will be dealing with deepfakes, but we haven't actually seen a whole lot of that yet," said US District Judge Jesse Furman of Manhattan, who chairs the panel and on Thursday appointed a subcommittee to further examine the issue. Experts from industry, academia and government warned that the issue is far from purely hypothetical. They said the courts' ability to act as gatekeepers against fabricated AI-generated evidence is only going to become more challenging. "Media generated from frontier models, at least in the last few generations, are indistinguishable by humans from authentic or AI-generated media," said Devin Norder, director of product management at Meta. "And the cost and the time it takes to create this media really are quite trivial at this point." Major companies including OpenAI and Meta have sought to adopt tools and services aimed at verifying the validity of visual content, and new laws in California and the European Union require "watermarking" aimed at detecting deepfakes. But Anderson warned that because each company has its own system, there's no universal means to reliably detect all watermarks or verify the authenticity of visual content. "My guess is that this absolutely will continue to get better," she said. "I do not think it'll ever be bulletproof." Despite those factors, Manhattan US District Judge Valerie Caproni, a member of the committee, expressed caution about the judiciary rushing to craft an AI-specific rule to address the issue, given the lack of data indicating that such a problem was plaguing the courts. She said even if courts began to regularly confront deepfakes, current rules and laws already make it illegal to submit fraudulent evidence and allow judges determine whether evidence was forged. "We've dealt with bad actors presenting fake evidence since Cain and Abel," she said. "That's a longstanding problem." item.title: Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to new province bordering Central African Republic
item.description: The ongoing Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to a new province bordering Central African Republic, two health officials said on Thursday, posing a fresh challenge for authorities struggling to contain it.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The ongoing Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to a new province bordering Central African Republic, two health officials said on Thursday, posing a fresh challenge for authorities struggling to contain it. North Ubangi becomes the eighth province to be affected by the outbreak of the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, which was announced in mid-May and has become the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record, with more than 9,000 cases and more than 4,000 deaths confirmed. Two cases have been confirmed in North Ubangi, the officials said. They have not been officially announced by Congolese authorities. Ituri province remains the epicentre of the outbreak though cases have increased recently in North [USN:L6N45H0P8 TEXT:"Kivu"] province. Cases have also been confirmed in South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and South Ubangi provinces. A health official in North Ubangi told Reuters on Thursday there had been a series of suspect deaths recently in a mining area in Wapinda health zone, close to the border with Bas-Uele, prompting samples to be analysed at a provincial laboratory and in Kinshasa. In addition to spreading within Congo, the outbreak has also resulted in cases in Uganda, which was declared Ebola-free in August, and in Kenya, which announced its [USN:L8N45S0GY TEXT:"first Ebola infection"] earlier this month and announced a second case - a close family member of the first one - on [USN:L6N46011B TEXT:"Wednesday"].

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 15 : Amazon unveiled two new devices on Thursday for listening to and recording people's information throughout the day to offer calendar reminders and other AI-driven insights under the Bee brand it acquired last year. Frontier is a bracelet and Eclipse is a brick that resembles a portable magnetic charger. Users attach the Eclipse to their smartphones. The devices aggregate information from calendars, apps and other data throughout the day, Amazon said.  The Frontier bracelet costs $75 and the Eclipse $100, Amazon said. "They listen to your whole day," said Amazon devices chief Panos Panay at the TechCrunch Disrupt conference in San Francisco. "It reminds you of the conversations you had, it reminds you of to-dos that you may have had, it tells you that you have some action items that you committed to other people."

USERS CONTROL PRIVACY: AMAZON He said that because the devices are always listening when turned on, users do not have to make reminders for themselves and "can stay more present" throughout the day. The company said users control privacy by deciding when to turn it on and can delete insights or prior conversations as they see fit. Amazon does not store audio.  The company faced criticism after reports in 2019 that thousands of people were listening to conversations people had with its Alexa voice assistant service. It is facing a class action lawsuit over the practice. Amazon has denied any wrongdoing. Bee will retain data for 14 days, though users can extend that by paying for a $12-per-month subscription. The devices can also connect to Alexa+, Amazon's subscription generative AI voice service. Amazon's Bee will face competition in AI wearables, notably Meta's Muse Charm, a pendant using the company's latest agentic AI software, and its eyeglasses with cameras and other sensors. A host of startups have also developed similar devices, designed to record conversations and take action on behalf of users. In recent weeks, Amazon has announced a flurry of new gadgets, part of Panay's effort to attract buyers willing to spend more for higher quality and durability. A slate of tablets Amazon announced last week costs as much as three times more than prior versions, despite slowing global sales of the portable computers. Reuters reported earlier this year that Amazon is considering a return to the smartphone market about a decade after the release of its failed Fire Phone.

Source: Reuters

Oct 15 : Anthropic has given nonprofit METR employee-level access to its systems and is in talks with others including Hugging Face, as AI companies pitch external evaluators as a way to safely advance the technology without slowing its development. The developer of Claude models is also working with biosecurity nonprofit SecureBio and Accenture's AI business Faculty as evaluators, it said in a blog post on Thursday. Reuters exclusively reported earlier this week that Anthropic and OpenAI had sought significant control over what outside reviewers could publish, concerned that the findings could leak trade secrets. A person familiar with the matter told Reuters that talks with Anthropic had evolved recently, with the company becoming more open in negotiations.

A key sticking point between evaluators and AI labs is that information the companies might consider crucial intellectual property can also be relevant to assessing a model's risks, leading to disputes and redactions, a separate person familiar with the discussions told Reuters. Experts have also said the independence of evaluators is a concern, as Anthropic and OpenAI choose who gets to carry out the reviews. The outcome of the talks will help determine how the world scrutinizes a technology that some of its creators warn may be advancing beyond humanity's ability to manage. THE METR TIE-UP Anthropic said on Thursday six employees of METR — or Model Evaluation and Threat Research — have company hardware, office space and access to internal systems roughly equivalent to its risk assessment teams. However, customer data, legally privileged information and model architecture will remain off limits. The company said it cannot veto METR's findings on risks, incidents and practices, but can require narrowly defined redactions. METR can also publicly question those redactions without revealing the withheld information. "In line with our transparency policies, our report will openly describe the scope, access, and other limitations of our work," METR said. The nonprofit had proposed on Wednesday that developers allow private staff interviews, timely publication of assessments and transparency about access limits and redactions. Anthropic said its other evaluator partnerships are at an early stage, with more limited access and publication rights.  The company is developing three tiers of access. Evaluators at the first level will conduct narrowly scoped investigations and need approval to publish. Those at the second will receive more information and can publish without approval, subject to redactions evaluators can publicly challenge. The third, used by METR, provides employee-like access with similar publication rights to the second tier. SecureBio is in the first tier and is reviewing the chemical and biological weapons chapter of Anthropic's August risk report, having published a pilot review of the previous report. Anthropic said it would consider expanding SecureBio's access and publication rights after the review. Anthropic also announced last month that it is working on a tie-up with Faculty covering model evaluations, adversarial testing and assessments of whether models behave as intended, among other areas.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Volvo Cars expands automated driving partnership with Nvidia
item.description: Volvo Cars is expanding its partnership with Nvidia to develop a new generation of driver-assistance and automated-driving technology, the companies said on Thursday, as carmakers race to bring increasingly advanced hands-free driving features to market.
item.dc:creator: Marie Mannes
item.content:encoded: Volvo Cars (VOLCARb.ST) is expanding its partnership with Nvidia (NVDA.O) to [USN:L6N3Y610S TEXT:"develop"] a new generation of driver-assistance and automated-driving technology, the companies said on Thursday, as carmakers race to bring increasingly advanced hands-free driving features to market. The companies said Volvo would combine its safety systems and engineering expertise with Nvidia's artificial intelligence and computing technologies, including the Hyperion sensor, computer architecture and autonomous-driving software stack. Automakers including Mercedes-Benz, BMW and Ford have been targeting more advanced automated-driving systems, from hands-free highway driving to self-driving in limited conditions. Tesla is [USN:L6N45R0YL TEXT:"pushing"] for broader [USN:L6N45V0PF TEXT:"approval"] of its assisted-driving technology in Europe, including urban areas with an EU-wide [USN:L6N45H0TX TEXT:"vote"] possible in December. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told reporters in Stockholm that partnering with Volvo provided the chipmaker with a "tremendous opportunity" because of the automaker's rigorous safety standards. Huang said features would be rolled out gradually. "As the car earns its trust and as Volvo becomes comfortable with the capabilities of the cars, they'll continue to expand the services that are available. There's no hurry, safety first," Huang said. Besides Volvo, Nvidia has [USN:L1N3Y90FP TEXT:"partnerships"] with a wide range of automakers, including Mercedes, Jaguar Land Rover and Hyundai. Volvo CEO Hakan Samuelsson said the company would take a cautious approach to deployment. "We will never let it out under conditions which we know are not safe," Samuelsson told reporters. The technology, which Volvo ultimately expects to support hands-free driving both in urban environments and on highways, should appear in Volvo vehicles before 2030 and will be launched in multiple regions simultaneously, excluding China, Alwin Bakkenes, Volvo Cars' head of software engineering, said. Volvo, majority-owned by China's Geely Holding (GEELY.UL), has not chosen a pricing model yet, Bakkenes said, but features would not be limited to higher-priced models.

item.title: Haas signs Rafael Camara to F1 seat to replace Esteban Ocon
item.description: Haas has signed 21-year-old Formula 2 driver Rafael Camara to fill its vacant Formula 1 seat starting in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Haas has signed 21-year-old Formula 2 driver Rafael Camara to fill its vacant Formula 1 seat starting in 2027. The Brazilian driver will replace Esteban Ocon, who announced last month that he is leaving Haas after two seasons. Camara, who currently leads the F2 standings as a rookie, secured a multi-year deal to make his F1 debut with Haas. Haas conducted tests with reserve drivers Ryo Hirakawa and Jack Doohan and reigning F2 champ Leonardo Fornaroli. Camara became the leading target, however, following a private test with Haas in August at Portimao in Portugal. "He showed when we had him drive in our (test) program in Portugal that he could handle himself very well with not a huge amount of time to learn the car," Ayao Komatsu, Haas F1 team principal, said in a statement. "He showed us more than just raw speed. Rafa managed to create an environment to get the best out of himself, it was very impressive and certainly the laps he completed were special." Camara, who joined the Ferrari Driver Academy in 2022, won the Formula 3 title in 2025 driving for Trident. He is driving for Invicta Racing this season and has recorded three wins and five pole positions. He leads the F2 standings by seven points with two races remaining. --Field Level Media

Oct 15 : Skydance's CNN, the Financial Times, Axios and other publishers joined Google's AI news program to license their content for generative AI features and explore ways to drive audience engagement. The search-engine giant said on Thursday that the program, which started as a pilot last year with partners like The Washington Post, now includes more than 400 publications globally. The deal marks CNN's first partnership since Paramount Skydance completed its acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery, as CEO David Ellison seeks to position the combined company as a technology-driven media business. As part of these agreements, publishers will provide enhanced content rights, allowing Google to develop new AI features, while Google will pay participating news organizations for their content. Financial terms were not disclosed.

"Google's innovation with generative AI has changed how people discover information and content, and now those tools will help us explore new ways to discover and engage audiences," said Sam Felix, CNN's senior vice president of strategic partnerships and business development. Google said the AI features will come with clear attribution and direct links, helping readers to connect with the sources they value. The announcement comes at a time when publishers are stepping up legal efforts to prevent AI companies from using their content without permission to train large language models. News publishers are also grappling with declining referral traffic as search engines roll out AI-generated answers that allow users to consume information without clicking through to websites. CNN said the deal is in line with its strategy to protect its intellectual property, adding that it has multiple commercial partnerships and ongoing discussions with other industry players. The network operates television, streaming and digital news services worldwide, including CNN International and CNN Originals, as well as a direct-to-consumer subscription service and CNN Newsource.

NEW YORK: The Nasdaq fell to near one-month lows on Thursday (Oct 15), weighed by a worsening selloff in AI-linked stocks on fears rising interest rates could impact artificial-intelligence investments, and fresh data pointing to building US price pressures. The S&P 500 and the Nasdaq marked their biggest one-day fall since July on Wednesday after hotter-than-expected consumer inflation data fuelled expectations of further interest- rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve, dragging on tech stocks. S emiconductor maker TSMC 's cautious note for 2027, citing macroeconomic uncert ai nties, also dented sentiment. Reports that AI lab Anthropic' s third-quarter revenue surged 45 per cent compared to the previous quarter failed to lift investor spirits.

Heavily indebted data-centre operator CoreWeave sitting in the eye of the recent tech storm, lost 8.5 per cent fol low ing a 15 per cent drop on Wednesday , while c loud computing giant Oracle was down marginally after a near ly 9 per cent fall in the previous session. The companies' bonds also fell, pushing their yields to record highs. Chipmakers lost ground, with Nvidia down 3.3 per cent, and Micron Technology and Advanced Micro Devices losing 5 per cent and 6.4 per cent, respectively. The broader chips index will have shed US$2 trillion in a more-than-14 per cent slide in seven sessions, if losses hold. It would mark its longest losing streak since May 2025. The S&P 500 information technology sector was the biggest drag, down 2 per cent. The slump pushed investors to government bonds, with the benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield at a three-week low of 5.0725 per cent. " Investors are increasingly questioning how much future growth is already priced into valuations, how expansion is being financed and when these investments will generate sufficient returns," Charu Chanana, chief investment strategist at Saxo, said in a note. "The repricing of CoreWeave's debt suggests that investors are becoming less willing to finance AI infrastructure growth at any cost."

Related:

Commentary: Every investment portfolio looks like the same trade - AI

At 9:50am ET (11:50pm, Singapore time), the Dow J one s Industrial Average rose 163.58 points, or 0.32 per cent, to 51,785.06, the S&P 500 shed 32 .20 points, or 0.42 per cent, to 7,686.74, and the Nasdaq Composite .IXIC lost 283.07 points, or 1.06 per cent, to 26,409.80. The CBOE Volatility Index, known as Wall Street's fear gauge, hit a two-week high and was last up 0.83 points at 17.74. Investors continued to segue into traditionally defensive sectors, with healthcare .SPXHC and consumer staples .SPLRCS rising more than 2 per cent each. Gains in these stocks propped up the Dow. The Nasdaq has dropped more than 4 per cent from record highs touched last week, with concerns about higher borrowing costs and AI spending threatening to eclipse the third-quarter earnings season, when S&P 500 profits are expected to grow 30.6 per cent, according to LSEG data. Data showed US producer prices increased by the most in 4-1/2 years in September amid rising goods and services costs, the latest indication of inflation broadening out beyond energy products. Markets will now scrutinize Fed Ch ai r Kevin Warsh's speech before the International M one tary Fund Annual Meeting. Shares of Rocket Lab dropped 1 5 per cent after the space company s ai d the inaugural launch of its new, larger Neutron rocket was delayed until next year. FMC slid over 38 per cent after the agrichemicals company sharply cut its third-quarter outlook, which includes a US$625 million-US$675 million hit from commercial actions. Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.78-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by a 1.05-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq. The S&P 500 posted 20 new 52-week highs and no new lows, while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 29 new highs and 261 new lows.

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: Ｇ７・Ｇ２０当局者、金融不安の切迫リスク認めず＝日本の財務省同行筋
item.description: [バンコク １５日 ロイター] - 日本の財務省同行筋によると、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）と２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）の会合に...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ｇ７・Ｇ２０当局者、金融不安の切迫リスク認めず＝日本の財務省同行筋 1:45 配信

タイ・バンコクで開催されたＩＭＦ・世銀総会に出席した当局者ら　REUTERS/Patipat Janthong

[バンコク １５日 ロイター] - 日本の財務省同行筋によると、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）と２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）の会合に出席した財務当局トップらは、最近の人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の市場急落によって金融システムが不安定化する差し迫ったリスクはないとの認識を示した。最近の株式市場の動向を特に取り上げて議論することはなかったという。

会合に出席した財務省同行筋は記者団に対し、両会合では、世界経済が外部からのショックに対して底堅さを示していることを前提に議論が行われたと説明した。ただ、政策当局者らは警戒を怠らず、金融システム危機の芽を放置しない必要性を確認したという。

さらに同筋は、市場動向は常に注意深く監視しているとしながらも、株式、為替、債券市場の個々の動きについてはコメントしないとした。

item.title: トランプ氏、死刑執行のライブ配信中止 国防長官の方針覆す
item.description: [ワシントン １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１５日、２００９年に南部テキサス州のフォートフッド陸軍基地で１３人を殺害した元陸軍精神科医のニダル・ハサン死刑囚の銃殺刑の執行をライブ配信する計画を中止した。執行の様子を広く公開する意向だったヘグセス米国防長官の方針を覆した。

ヘグセス長官は今月、ニダル・ハサン死刑囚を１２月３日に銃殺刑に処すと発表した。執行場所はハサン死刑囚が事件を起こした基地とし、その様子を生中継すると述べて多くの人を驚かせた。司法手続きに基づく死刑執行をテレビやインターネットで生中継している国は、他に知られていない。

匿名を条件に取材に応じたホワイトハウス当局者によると、トランプ氏と側近らは、ヘグセス氏がメディアのインタビューで発表するまでライブ配信の計画を知らなかった。

トランプ氏はＳＮＳへの投稿で「米国がテロリストやハサンのようなクズにどう対処するかを世界に示すため、誰もが見られるよう死刑執行を配信することは、強力な抑止力になり得たと思う。しかし、多くの善良で善意ある人々は、配信であれ他の映像手段であれ、彼が死ぬところを見たくないと考えている」と説明。「予定通り銃殺刑に処されるが、その様子は配信しない」と投稿した。

死刑のライブ配信計画には、バンス副大統領を含む共和党の複数の政治家のほか、宗教指導者や海外の識者からも疑問の声が上がっていた。

BERLIN, Oct 15 : Germany plans a wide-ranging cooperation agreement with US chip maker Nvidia to boost the take-up of artificial intelligence in German industry, business daily Handelsblatt said on Thursday, citing people familiar with the issue. It said the deal would be announced next week at the Invest in Germany conference in Berlin, where Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang will be a guest. The aim of the deal would be two-fold, the newspaper said. Firstly, it would create the basis for physical AI tools, used in training robots or self-driving vehicles. Secondly, it would help to create high-performance AI models for industry. The newspaper said the agreement would involve investments in the hundreds of millions of euros.

item.title: IEA to speed up oil stocks release including over 20 million barrels of diesel
item.description: The International Energy Agency agreed on Thursday to release over 20 million barrels of diesel to the market and any oil remaining from a record emergency reserves release pledged in March to boost supply and cool soaring prices.
item.dc:creator: Forrest Crellin, Robert Harvey, Pietro Lombardi
item.content:encoded: The International Energy Agency agreed on Thursday to release over 20 million barrels of diesel to the market and any oil remaining from a record emergency reserves release pledged in March to boost supply and cool soaring prices. US President Donald Trump has pressed European Union countries to draw down reserves or face a potential US diesel export ban as he seeks to lower prices ahead of November 3 [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"]. Diesel prices have surged to record highs in many markets due to disrupted supply because of the Iran war and the Russia-Ukraine conflict, posing inflation and cost-of-living threats to governments and consumers. The 32-nation IEA's board met on Thursday to discuss the scale and timing of stock releases. "The IEA governing board reaffirmed its commitment to continue delivering on the March 2026 Collective Action in response to the Strait of Hormuz crisis," it said in a statement after the meeting. In March, countries had pledged to release more than 400 million barrels of crude and oil products as prices soared. On Thursday, members "agreed to accelerate the release of the remaining volumes, with specific plans already in place, including over 20 million barrels of diesel as soon as possible." SOME DISAPPOINTMENT OVER LACK OF EXTRA BARRELS Reuters reported this month that EU governments were discussing a [USN:S8N43A07P TEXT:"French proposal"] for the release of 50 million barrels of diesel alongside 50 million barrels of crude from IEA members. "The IEA announcement is a step in the right direction, but falls short on the details the market was looking for," said Abhishek Kumar, an analyst at Sparta Commodities. "The 20+ million barrels of diesel appear to be an acceleration of existing commitments rather than genuinely new volumes." The IEA, which coordinates industrialised nations' releases of oil from emergency stocks, said some members had already released more than they pledged in March and that others planned to do so. Members have released approximately 330 million barrels so far, the IEA said. The US Energy Department said further IEA releases, with a focus on diesel, are under review and in progress, citing the IEA statement. But the Trump administration "continues to hold European nations accountable for failing to fulfill their previous commitments to minimize supply disruptions in global energy markets and to help lower energy prices," the Energy Department spokesperson added. The White House, when asked if it was unhappy with the IEA's commitment to draw down reserves, provided the IEA's statement from Thursday on the releases. Spain [USN:L8N4610R5 TEXT:"said on Thursday"] it would release 4.4 million barrels from strategic reserves in October. Spain has released 3.7 million of the 11.5 million barrels it pledged in March.

item.title: 米、ＡＩから「ＳＩ」への呼称変更主張 ＩＭＦ声明巡り＝財務次官
item.description:
Andrea Shalal
[バンコク １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrea Shalal

[バンコク　１５日　ロイター] - ブラウン米財務次官（国際問題担当）は１５日、ロイターとのインタビューで、国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）が準備中の声明で、人工知能（ＡＩ）の名称を「スーパーインテリジェンス」（超知能、ＳＩ）に変更するよう求めていると明らかにした。関係者によると、米国は関連会合でも名称変更を主張し、参加者から驚きの声が上がったという。

トランプ大統領は今年９月、新名称を使用するよう政府機関に指示。ブラウン氏によると、ＩＭＦの運営委員会、国際通貨金融委員会（ＩＭＦＣ）が起草中の声明で、新しい用語を使用するかどうか協議しているという。

米国は今年、２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）の議長国を務めており、ブラウン氏は名称変更が定着することを望んでいると述べた。「ＳＩ」は技術をより適切に表現しており、変更は米国の明確な優先事項だと説明した。

名称変更が受け入れられずに米政権が声明を支持しない場合、ＩＭＦＣ議長のサウジアラビアのジャドアーン財務相が「議長声明」に切り替える可能性がある。関係者は、ＳＩやＡＩを直接は盛り込まず「新技術」とするような妥協案も考えられると指摘した。

ＩＭＦＣは１７日、ジャドアーン氏とＩＭＦのゲオルギエワ専務理事が記者会見を開き、声明を発表する予定。

item.title: 米企業在庫 8月は前月比0.4％増 予想と一致
item.description: [ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が１５日発表した８月の企業在庫は、前月比０．４％増加し、エコノミスト予想...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米企業在庫　8月は前月比0.4％増　予想と一致 0:24 配信

米イリノイ州グレンビューのＡＢＴエレクトロニクスの施設。2018年12月撮影。 REUTERS/Richa Naidu

[ワシントン　１５日　ロイター] - 米商務省が１５日発表した８月の企業在庫は、前月比０．４％増加し、エコノミスト予想と一致した。売上高が堅調に伸びる中、在庫も緩やかな増加となった。

前年同月比では４．６％増加した。企業は、個人消費や人工知能（ＡＩ）投資に主に支えられた堅調な国内需要を背景に５四半期連続で在庫を取り崩した後、積み増しに転じている。ただ、在庫積み増しの大部分は輸入に依存しており、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）成長率の押し下げ要因となっている。

８月の小売在庫は０．２％増加した。先月公表された速報値の０．３％増から下方改定された。７月は０．９％増だった。自動車在庫は０．８％増と速報値から変わらず。７月は１．０％増だった。

ＧＤＰ算出に用いられる自動車を除く小売在庫は横ばいとなり、先月公表された速報値の０．１％増から下方改定された。７月は０．８％増だった。

卸売在庫と製造業者の在庫は０．５％、それぞれ増加した。

企業売上高は１．１％増加。前月は０．５％増だった。

８月の販売ペースに基づく在庫解消に必要な期間は１．３３カ月と、７月の１．３４カ月から短縮した。前年同月は１．４０カ月だった。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：出遅れ気味の米不動産株、持ち直し期待高まる 焦点：後退する米企業役員の多様性、トランプ米大統領の政策反映 コラム：「米国例外主義」なお健在、外国投資家のテック株流入持続が示唆 アングル：米株、下半期の上昇基調維持に多くの試練　ＡＩ投資から金融政策まで 最終更新: 10/16(金) 0:24 ロイター

item.title: ヒズボラ、レバノン押収の爆薬所有認め返還要求 「イスラエル攻撃用」
item.description: [ベイルート １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ベイルート １５日 ロイター] - イラン支援下にあるレバノンの武装組織ヒズボラに所属する議員は１５日、同国の治安部隊が先週押収した数百キログラムの爆薬について、ヒズボラのものだと明らかにした。政府が進めるヒズボラの武装解除を巡り、緊張が続いている。

レバノン当局は先週、東部ベカー地方の検問所で爆薬を積んだ車両を発見し、乗っていた２人を逮捕した。

当局は当時、車両が誰のものか明らかにしなかったため、国内では車爆弾による暗殺や、国内の不安定化を狙った別の攻撃に爆薬が使われるのではないかとの懸念が広がった。

ヒズボラのハサン・ファドララ議員は１５日、レバノン議会で記者団に対し、爆薬はイスラエルに対して使用する予定だったと説明した。イスラエル軍はレバノン領の広い範囲を制圧・占領している。

ファドララ氏によると、ヒズボラは直ちに治安機関に連絡し、車両と積み荷が同組織のものであると説明。爆薬などの返還と、拘束された２人の釈放を要求した。

同氏が所有を認めたことは、国内の全ての武器を国家の管理下に置くという政府の方針にもかかわらず、ヒズボラが国内で武器の輸送を継続していることを示している。

米国の仲介によるレバノンとイスラエルの協議で成立した合意に基づき、レバノン政府はヒズボラの武装解除を約束した。しかし、ヒズボラはイスラエル軍がレバノン領内にとどまる限り武装解除を拒否するとしており、イスラエルもレバノン南部各地で攻撃を続けている。

レバノン大統領府によると、アウン大統領は１５日、ルビオ米国務長官と電話会談を行った。会談でアウン氏は、レバノン軍と治安部隊は武力誇示の阻止、武器・弾薬の押収、密輸の取り締まりに関する決定を全面的に履行していると伝えた。治安機関が最近講じた措置もこうした取り組みの一環だと説明。 司法当局は付託された全ての事件を追及し、違反者に寛大な対応は取らないと述べた。

item.title: FBI, US Postal Service investigate suspicious mailings to election officials, lawmakers
item.description: The FBI and US Postal Service's law enforcement arm said on Thursday they were investigating suspicious mailings, including some sent to state election officials and lawmakers' offices ahead of the November 3 midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The FBI and US Postal Service's law enforcement arm said on Thursday they were investigating suspicious mailings, including some sent to state election officials and lawmakers' offices ahead of the November 3 midterm elections. The FBI said some of the letters contained an unknown substance. The investigation come less than three weeks before the midterms, which will determine control of the US Congress, as the Postal Service prepares to handle millions of mailed ballots. Spokespeople for Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer, Alex Padilla, a California Democrat, and Chris Murphy, a Connecticut Democrat, all said the US Postal Service intercepted letters containing a suspicious substance mailed to their offices. "This incident is a stark reminder of the very real dangers facing those who serve the public and who help administer our elections," Padilla said in a statement. The US House of Representatives sergeant at arms, the House's chief law enforcement officer, told staff in an email seen by Reuters that some public officials had received letters containing suspicious white powder substances. Brendan Donahue, a deputy chief inspector with the US Postal Inspection Service, said some suspicious letters had been intercepted and that an investigation was ongoing. "We are committed to protecting our nation's election officials from threatening and dangerous mail. Any threat or attack on an election official is unacceptable," Donahue told reporters. The National Association of Secretaries of State and the National Association of State Election Directors said late on Wednesday a series of suspicious letters was sent to state election offices. Letters bound for several state election offices were intercepted before they were delivered, including in Pennsylvania, Ohio and Idaho. The Wisconsin Elections Commission said on Thursday it received a suspicious letter with an unidentified powdery substance that was deemed not hazardous. "Let this be very clear: this incident will not shake us,” said Meagan Wolfe, the state’s chief election official. An email to Senate staff said suspicious letters could have postmarks that do not match the return address and included an image of an envelope with a return address labeled "DSA" and a New York City address. POSTAL SERVICE PLANS NEW MEASURES Earlier on Thursday, US Postmaster General David Steiner said USPS was "absolutely ready" to handle millions of ballots for the midterm elections. USPS said this month it would take "extraordinary measures" for the 2026 election, including extending hours at some retail locations and expediting handling, extra deliveries and special pickups of ballots. On September 14, the US Supreme Court declined to let USPS enforce a rule targeting mail-in ballots, dealing a setback to President Donald Trump's effort to restrict voting by mail. USPS said it would not enforce the rule under the order. The agency adopted the measure after Trump issued a March executive order aimed at tightening rules governing mail voting. In 2024, USPS delivered 99.2 million ballots to and from voters in the presidential election. About 30% of votes were cast by mail in the November 2024 presidential election, down from 46% in 2020. Trump's fellow Republicans are locked in a tight battle to retain control of Congress in the midterms. Democratic voters disproportionately use mail-in ballots, according to various surveys, so restricting them could benefit Republicans. Under the rule that was blocked, states would have had to provide lists of mail-ballot recipients to USPS and use agency-approved outbound and return ballot mail envelopes outfitted with unique barcodes. The Postal Service could then have refused to send out ballots that did not comply or were associated with voters not appearing on the lists.

item.title: US delays small imports rule that raised alarm over prescription drug costs
item.description: The US government has delayed by 90 days implementation of new customs requirements for small international mail shipments, a move that should forestall higher prices for imported prescription drugs and other products for inflation-weary Americans until after the November midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Kamal Choudhury
item.content:encoded: The US government has delayed by 90 days implementation of new customs requirements for small international mail shipments, a move that should forestall higher prices for imported prescription drugs and other products for inflation-weary Americans until after the November midterm elections . The US Customs and Border Protection rule targets the [USN:L1N44A13F TEXT:"de minimis tariffs exemption"], which has eased requirements for shipments under $800. The rule aimed to speed up implementation of changes authorized by US lawmakers as part of President Donald Trump's spending and tax-cut bill, which are due to take effect in July 2027. The agency said on Wednesday it has pushed the mandatory compliance date for a new mail entry process to January 20, 2027, from October 22. That prior deadline was just 12 days before the November 3 elections in which US households' affordability woes are a central issue dogging Trump's Republican Party with control of Congress up for grabs. It said there would be no changes to international mail entry procedures before then. The process requires electronic filing for postal shipments subject to Section 201, 232 or 301 duties, or under the jurisdiction of a partner government agency such as the US Food and Drug Administration. It also involves a customs bond. As the October 22 deadline approached, patient advocates and industry groups had warned the rule's data and bonding requirements could cause delays, refusals or added costs for personal drug orders. IMPACT ON PHARMA The FDA officially bars individuals from importing foreign prescription drugs, but it has discretion in limited circumstances. Some Americans order medicines from other countries like Canada, where the cost of drugs can be sharply lower. The Canadian International Pharmacy Association has said most routine personal orders from licensed foreign pharmacies could be disrupted. A separate letter signed by 71 members of Congress, led by Democratic Representatives Jan Schakowsky of Illinois and Wisconsin's Mark Pocan, asked agencies to delay the procedures for prescription medicines unless personal-use drugs were assured. “For patients concerned about losing access to lower-cost prescriptions from abroad, this delay is a welcome reprieve, but not a permanent solution," said Merith Basey, CEO of Patients For Affordable Drugs. "Until patients in the US can get access to the prescription drugs they need at prices they can afford, disrupting existing personal-importation practices risks an important safety valve.” The Department of Health and Human Services referred questions to CBP, which did not immediately respond to a request for comment on whether personal-use exemptions are planned. CBP said the extension gives importers, brokers and logistics providers more time to update processes, helps avoid disruptions and will close gaps that have been exploited by smugglers. CBP's announcement did not mention medicines, and the rule does not name them.

item.title: Italian holding company Delfin explores funding for potential internal stake buyout, sources say
item.description: Delfin, the holding company of Italy's Del Vecchio family and top shareholder in EssilorLuxottica , has held preliminary talks with banks to explore financing options for a possible purchase of stakes in Delfin held by one or more shareholders, two people close to the matter said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Delfin, the holding company of Italy's Del Vecchio family and top shareholder in EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) , has held preliminary talks with banks to explore financing options for a possible purchase of stakes in Delfin held by one or more shareholders, two people close to the matter said on Thursday. Disagreements among the eight heirs of late EssilorLuxottica founder Leonardo Del Vecchio have left Delfin in a prolonged deadlock, preventing the family from ending a succession dispute and acting cohesively to influence decisions at the holding company. The discussions on taking over stakes are at a very early stage and there is no certainty they will lead to a transaction, the people added. Delfin declined to comment. Italy's Corriere della Sera reported on Thursday that Delfin was exploring the acquisition of two shareholders' stakes, equivalent to about 25% of the company. It did not identify the two shareholders. Such a deal would reduce the number of heirs holding shares in Delfin from eight to six, leaving each with an interest of roughly 16.5% instead of 12.5%. Delfin has a net asset value estimated at around €40 billion ($44.87 billion), with the bulk of it coming from the 32.4% stake in EssilorLuxottica. It also has minority stakes in Italian bank MPS (BMPS.MI) and insurer Assicurazioni Generali (GASI.MI) among others. In the first half of this year, Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio sought to buy out two of his siblings, offering around €10 billion for a combined 25% stake in Delfin, but the deal [USN:L1N4320JW TEXT:"did not materialise"]. At that time, EssilorLuxottica CEO Francesco Milleri, who is also Delfin chair, [USN:S8N3YM04U TEXT:"welcomed"] a streamlined Delfin ownership structure. Italian daily Il Sole 24 Ore reported on Thursday that discussions were focused on a possible acquisition by Delfin of the 12.5% stake held by Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio, who earlier this week renewed criticism of Chief Executive Francesco Milleri's leadership of EssilorLuxottica. ($1 = 0.8914 euros)

item.title: コアウィーブ株再び急落、25年5月以来安値 ＡＩ投資に債務懸念
item.description:
Aditya Soni Anhata Rooprai
[１５日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
コアウィーブ株再び急落、25年5月以来安値　ＡＩ投資に債務懸念 0:03 配信

コアウィーブのロゴ。7月20日撮影のイメージ写真。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Aditya Soni　Anhata Rooprai

[１５日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを提供するコアウィーブの株式と社債が１５日、再び急落した。最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が受注残の多さを強調したにもかかわらず、借入金による資金調達にますます依存するＡＩインフラの拡充を巡り、信用不安が高まっていることが鮮明となった。株価は一時、８．３％下落し、２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。

同社は約５００億ドルの債務を抱えており、データセンターブームが信用により支えられているという懸念の象徴となっている。また、新興企業の経営を圧迫しているほか、グーグルの持ち株会社アルファベットやメタ・プラットフォームズのような大手企業のキャッシュフローにまで圧力をかけている。

同社が４月に発行した２０３１年償還の社債の利回りは１６．２％となり、通常は財務悪化を示唆する水準を上回った。トレードウェブのデータによると、同社債の直近の価格は額面１ドルに対し０．０１１ドル安の０．７８４ドル。同社の債務に対するデフォルト保険コストは約１０００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）に上昇し、５年以内のデフォルト確率が約６３％であることを示唆する水準となった。１年前の同確率は約３０％だった。

同社の株価は１４日にも約１５％下落しており、ハイテク株売りの中でも下落幅の大きい銘柄の一つとなっている。

ＩＧグループのチーフテクニカルアナリスト、アクセル・ルドルフ氏は「ＡＩ需要と、収益性のあるビジネスモデルとは全く別物だということに市場は気付き始めている」と指摘。「現時点では、ＡＩコンピューティングへの需要が突然冷え込んだというよりは、投資家がインフラ拡充の資金調達方法を疑問視しているように見える。ただ、資本コストが上がり続ければ、需要が堅調であっても、過剰にレバレッジを掛けている企業を守るには十分でなくなる可能性がある」と述べた。

一方、同社の第２位の株主で約１０％の株式を保有する半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンＣＥＯは、こうした懸念を一蹴。ストックホルムでのイベントで記者団に対し「コアウィーブの財務力は日々改善している」とした上で、エヌビディアによる同社への支援は必要ないとの認識を示した。「私は楽観的だ。コアウィーブの資本コストは実際に下がっている」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ株売りに勢い、資金調達に懸念　クライマックスには距離 アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か 最終更新: 10/16(金) 2:16 ロイター

item.title: Bones from Iraqi cave hint at violence and compassion in Neanderthals
item.description: Oct 15 : The bones of a Neanderthal from a cave in Iraq's Kurdistan region are offering evidence of both violence and compassion in the closest evolutionary cousins of our species, exhibiting a wound apparently from a fatal spear attack as well as signs of an earlier nonfatal injury that may have elicited kindly car

item.content:encoded:

Bones from Iraqi cave hint at violence and compassion in Neanderthals

The entrance to Shanidar Cave in Iraq's Kurdistan region, a site of important Neanderthal remains, is seen in an undated photograph released on October 15, 2026. Prof Graeme Barker/Handout via REUTERS NO RESALES. NO ARCHIVES. THIS IMAGE HAS BEEN SUPPLIED BY A THIRD PARTY

FAST

Oct 15 : The bones of a Neanderthal from a cave in Iraq's Kurdistan region are offering evidence of both violence and compassion in the closest evolutionary cousins of our species, exhibiting a wound apparently from a fatal spear attack as well as signs of an earlier nonfatal injury that may have elicited kindly care. Researchers have discovered at Shanidar Cave in the Zagros Mountains of northern Iraq a partial skeleton of a Neanderthal, aged in the mid-40s, that included a left shoulder blade, or scapula, with a circular hole six-tenths of an inch (15 mm) wide indicative of a deeply penetrating stab. The bones of this individual, who they call Shanidar A, were unearthed from under about 25 feet (7.5 meters) of rocks and sediment inside the cave and date to about 75,000 years ago. The researchers were unable to determine Shanidar A's sex. The researchers said the injury's shape suggests it was caused by a forceful thrust using a sharpened wooden spear, a type of weapon Neanderthals are known to have used, rather than a spear with a stone tip. It was a weapon employed in hunting large mammals that were an important food source.

"The spear would have gone through the skin and major muscles, especially the pectoralis, as well as the ribcage and muscles between the ribs, and the lung," said biological anthropologist Emma Pomeroy of the University of Cambridge in England, lead author of the study published on Thursday in the journal Scientific Reports. "The location could be like the kind of 'heart shot' hunters use to kill animals quickly by puncturing the heart, but that is a bit speculative. We do see heart shots as a hunting strategy both today and in the archaeological record. Neanderthals would have known this would lead to a quick death," Pomeroy said. University of Cambridge archaeologist and study co-author Graeme Barker, who has led Shanidar Cave excavations since 2015, said the likeliest scenario is interpersonal violence. The researchers said the violence probably occurred either between members of a particular Neanderthal group or between members of rival Neanderthal groups, calling a Homo sapiens attack or an accidental injury less likely. The researchers found shards of bone displaced by the weapon. The injury indicated that the spear entered from above with a downward trajectory, penetrating the left chest cavity from the front and traveling through the body before punching the hole in the scapula, causing quick death. ANOTHER INJURY In addition to the scapula, the researchers found some ribs, a nearly complete right hand and seven teeth, mostly from the front of the lower jaw, belonging to Shanidar A. The teeth bore evidence that this Neanderthal had survived brutal injury at least a year before death — a blow to the face resulting in front teeth being smashed and lost. One tooth was split, with half remaining rotated in the mouth and others pushed out of position. "The pain would have been extreme, and basic needs like eating and drinking would have been difficult, perhaps meaning Shanidar A needed food mashing and being able to rest. It's likely that Shanidar A did need some care from members of the group for some basic needs during recovery," Pomeroy said. Shanidar A was one of five Neanderthals, four adults and one infant, whose bodies were carefully tucked behind a rock pillar in the cave in a burial cluster within a generation or so of each other. The cave was occupied by Neanderthals for tens of thousands of years as a seasonal campsite, and later by Homo sapiens. Neanderthals were more robustly built than Homo sapiens, with larger brows. They lived as hunter-gatherers and inhabited Eurasia from the Atlantic coast to the Ural Mountains from about 400,000 years ago until a bit after 40,000 years ago, disappearing after Homo sapiens became established in the region. The two species interbred, with modern non-African human populations bearing residual Neanderthal DNA. The cave, overlooking the Great Zab river valley, has been a source of information about Neanderthals since the 1950s, with Shanidar A now offering new insight into their behavior. "We see evidence of two contrasting facets of human nature – care and violence – juxtaposed in the same individual," Pomeroy said. "We see evidence all around us today that violence and care are both aspects of how we humans behave, and we see this here in Shanidar A, too. Neanderthals were like us in many respects, both the good and the bad, and this find really highlights that, going against stereotypes of Neanderthals as unintelligent, uncaring cavemen and cavewomen," Pomeroy said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: El S&P 500 cierra en alza; los inversores se pasan de la inteligencia artificial al sector de salud
item.description: El S&P 500 cerró con un alza el jueves, recuperándose de pérdidas iniciales, ya que los inversores, preocupados por las acciones del sector de la inteligencia artificial (IA), se decantaron por Eli Lilly, UnitedHealth y otras de los sectores de salud y de consumo.
item.dc:creator: Noel Randewich, Sruthi Shankar
item.content:encoded: El S&P 500 cerró con un alza el jueves, recuperándose de pérdidas iniciales, ya que los inversores, preocupados por las acciones del sector de la inteligencia artificial (IA), se decantaron por Eli Lilly, UnitedHealth y otras de los sectores de salud y de consumo. Varias acciones tecnológicas cayeron, ya que los inversores analizaron con detenimiento las empresas relacionadas con la inteligencia artificial, cuyo alto endeudamiento las hace vulnerables a las subidas de las tasas de interés. Las acciones de Eli Lilly (LLY.N) , UnitedHealth (UNH.N) y Walmart repuntaron después de que Deutsche Bank revisó al alza sus recomendaciones. Broadcom (AVGO.O) y Nvidia (NVDA.O) bajaron después de que el fabricante de chips TSMC (2330.TW) se mostró cauto sobre 2027, a pesar de reportar por sexto trimestre consecutivo una ganancia récord gracias a la sólida demanda impulsada por la inteligencia artificial. Dell Technologies (DELL.N) y Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE.N) profundizaron las fuertes pérdidas de la sesión anterior, debido a la preocupación por las empresas de IA expuestas a unos costos de financiamiento más altos. El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro a 10 años retrocedió, pero se mantuvo cerca de máximos de varios años, ya que a los inversores les preocupa la inflación relacionada con los altos precios del petróleo. "El costo de financiar cualquier cosa, ya sea una nueva vivienda unifamiliar o un gigantesco centro de datos, está aumentando, y eso tiene implicaciones para muchos aspectos del mercado bursátil", dijo Jed Ellerbroek, gestor de carteras de Argent Capital Management. "Las acciones con mejor rendimiento hoy son las de empresas defensivas y no cíclicas". El índice de semiconductores de Filadelfia (.SOX) cayó por séptima sesión consecutiva. Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) subió 24,94 puntos, un 0,32%, a 7.744,07 unidades; el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganó 18,37 puntos, un 0,07%, a 26.711,24 unidades; el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) sumó 559,45 puntos, o un 1,08%, a 52.180,93 unidades.

item.title: Trump shuts down Hegseth plan to livestream military execution
item.description: "Many very good and well meaning people would rather not watch him die," the US president said.

Trump shuts down Hegseth plan to livestream military execution

"Many very good and well meaning people would rather not watch him die," the US president said.

US President Donald Trump delivers remarks in Wasilla, Alaska, US, on Oct 13, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Evan Vucci)

FAST

WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump scrapped plans to livestream the execution of the former Army major who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, overruling Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth on Thursday (Oct 15) after the proposal drew opposition from Republicans, religious leaders and the public. The reversal ended a plan to broadcast Nidal Hasan’s Dec 3 firing-squad execution. It also marked a rare public disagreement between Trump and one of the president’s closest allies, although the Pentagon said the two were “completely aligned.” Hegseth had announced plans to livestream the execution at the Fort Hood military base in Texas, the site of Hasan's 2009 attack. No other country is known to televise or livestream judicial executions. Trump and his advisers had been unaware of the livestream plan, said a White House official speaking on condition of anonymity.

"I think streaming the execution for all to see might have been a strong deterrent for the World to witness how America deals with Terrorists and SCUM like Hasan but, many very good and well meaning people would rather not watch him die, through streaming, or through any other visual device," Trump wrote in a social media post. "He will die, as scheduled, by firing squad, but this event will not be streamed." The families of Hasan's victims will be able to view the execution in person if they so choose, as is standard at US executions. Some of Trump 's fellow Republicans, including Vice President JD Vance, as well as religious leaders had expressed everything from doubts to outright condemnation of the Pentagon's livestream plan. Opinion polls showed a majority of Americans opposed livestreaming it. Archbishop Timothy Broglio, who oversees the spiritual care of Catholic members of the US armed forces, also raised objections, while Pope Leo condemned capital punishment in all its forms. An attorney representing Hasan could not immediately be reached for comment, and it was unclear if the scheduled Dec 3 execution date would be delayed by legal challenges.

A SPLIT WITH HEGSETH It was Trump 's first major public split with Hegseth, a Trump ally. But it was unclear whether the split would politically imperil Hegseth given their strong ties. In a statement, the Pentagon said Trump spoke with Hegseth about the decision before announcing it on Truth Social. "The Secretary supports the President's decision, and they are completely aligned," chief Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell said in a statement. Capital punishment in the US already was facing renewed scrutiny after Christa Pike, convicted of murder in the 1990s, survived two lethal injections in a failed execution attempt by Tennessee last month that left her badly injured and requiring hospitalisation.

Outrage over US military plan to livestream firing squad execution

US House Speaker says execution livestream could be terrorist 'recruiting tool'

"SERIOUS CONSEQUENCES" A military jury convicted Hasan, a former US Army psychiatrist, of premeditated murder for fatally shooting 13 unarmed soldiers and wounding 32 others in a medical facility at the vast base. Law enforcement shot Hasan during his rampage, paralyzing him from the waist down, and he now uses a wheelchair. Hegseth had said the broadcasting of the execution was needed to ensure that people understand that "there's serious consequences for these types of things." Midterm elections on Nov 3 will determine whether Republicans retain control of Congress as voters increasingly register disapproval of Trump 's policies in opinion polls. Senator John Curtis, a Republican representing Utah, called the cancellation "the right move" in a statement. US Representative Richard Neal, a Democrat from Massachusetts, called the original plan "a profound failure of moral judgment and basic human decency."

Source: Reuters/co/fs

item.description: ［ニューヨーク １５日 ロイター］ - １５日午前の米株式市場は、ナスダック総合が約１カ月ぶりの安値圏に下落した。金利...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場・午前＝ナスダック1カ月ぶり安値圏、ＡＩ株売り加速 10/15 23:43 配信

2026年9月15日、ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE） REUTERS/Jeenah Moon/File Photo

［ニューヨーク　１５日　ロイター］ - １５日午前の米株式市場は、ナスダック総合が約１カ月ぶりの安値圏に下落した。金利上昇が人工知能（ＡＩ）投資に影響するとの懸念からＡＩ関連株の売りが加速したほか、経済指標が米国の物価上昇圧力の強まりを示したことも重しとなった。

半導体メーカーの台湾積体電路製造（ＴＳＭＣ）が、マクロ経済の不確実性を理由に２０２７年の見通しについて慎重な姿勢を示したことも、投資家心理を圧迫した。

多額の債務を抱えるデータセンター運営会社コアウィーブは、最近のハイテク株急落の中心にあり、前日の１５％安に続いて８．５％下落。クラウド大手オラクルも、前日の約９％安に続き小幅安となった。

半導体株も下落し、エヌビディアは３．３％安、マイクロン・テクノロジーは５％安、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイシズ（ＡＭＤ）は６．４％安となった。

サクソのチーフ投資ストラテジスト、チャル・チャナナ氏は「投資家は、将来の成長が株価評価にどこまで織り込まれているのか、事業拡大の資金をどう調達しているのか、そして投資がいつ十分な収益を生むのかについて、疑問を強めている。コアウィーブの社債価格の調整は、ＡＩインフラの拡大にどんな条件でも資金を提供しようとする投資家の姿勢が弱まっていることを示唆している」とした。

「恐怖指数」として知られるＣＢＯＥボラティリティー指数（ＶＩＸ）は２週間ぶりの高水準を付け、０．８３ポイント高の１７．７４となった。

item.title: Yemen's Houthis hit palace in Aden, coalition details attacks on Saudi infrastructure
item.description: Yemen's Houthis fired missiles at the presidential palace complex in the southern city of Aden on Thursday, killing five people, the government said, as the Saudi-led coalition listed dozens of Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure in recent weeks.
item.dc:creator: Enas Alashray, Mohammed Ghobari, Eman Abouhassira
item.content:encoded: Yemen's Houthis fired missiles at the presidential palace complex in the southern city of Aden on Thursday, killing five people, the government said, as the Saudi-led coalition listed dozens of Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure in recent weeks. The attack was the first in the current conflict between the Iran-aligned Houthis and Saudi Arabia on Aden's Al-Maashiq palace, the seat of Yemen's Saudi-backed and internationally recognised government. The conflict is a new theatre in the wider regional war that began with US and Israeli strikes on Iran in February. Yemen's prime minister and cabinet members were safe following the attack, Yemeni Information Minister Moammar al-Eryani said. Witnesses told Reuters they heard loud booms near the palace. Yemen's cabinet said the attack involved missiles and drones. Yemen's health minister Qasim Buhaibeh said five people were killed and 16 wounded in what he described as a Houthi attack on the government's official headquarters at the presidential complex. The casualties included guards and civilian employees. Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said its fighters had bombed what he described as the Saudi military operations headquarters in Aden, as part of the group's declared policy of targeting "Saudi reinforcements wherever they were located". The Houthi-run news agency SABA said the headquarters was run by Saudi officers and that there were weapons depots there. Reuters could not independently verify the claims. Fighting between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces resumed last month, and aid agencies [USN:L6N4600ML TEXT:"have warned"] of rapidly worsening conditions in Yemen. Last week, government forces launched a campaign to recapture areas controlled by the Houthis, recovering ground near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a key shipping artery. War broke out in Yemen in 2014 when [USN:L1N45Q02Z TEXT:"the Houthis"] seized the capital Sanaa, driving the government south. A Saudi-led military intervention the following year led to a bloody stalemate before a 2022 truce that held until this year. In that phase of the conflict Houthi fighters and allied forces briefly seized Al-Maashiq palace during a battle for Aden, before withdrawing. COALITION SAYS HOUTHIS ARE GETTING MISSILES, FAST BOATS As Saudi Arabia backs government forces, the Houthis [USN:L1N4610L5 TEXT:"have been firing"] ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi airports, ports and oil installations, turning US ally Saudi Arabia into a [USN:L1N46108L TEXT:"pressure point"] in the wider war [USN:L6N45Y0GN TEXT:"and threatening"] its ambitious economic plans. On Thursday, the Saudi-led military coalition said the Houthis had attempted to attack dozens of such sites, highlighting the risk to Saudi civilian infrastructure. The governing council of the UN's International Civil Aviation Organization condemned the recent attacks on civilian airports, aircraft, and aviation infrastructure in Saudi Arabia. Coalition spokesperson Turki al-Maliki told reporters that the Houthis had launched 20 attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh this month, killing 17 people and wounding 333 others. The airport is one of Saudi Arabia's main international aviation hubs. The coalition said Houthi attacks on Abha airport in southwestern Saudi Arabia near the Yemeni border had killed three people and wounded 28. Maliki said the Houthis had acquired advanced military technology with the help of "regional actors," including ballistic missiles, drones and explosive-laden fast boats. Iran [USN:L1N43P0D6 TEXT:"has provided"] weapons, money and training to the Houthis, although Tehran has officially denied arming them in violation of a UN arms embargo. Maliki also said the coalition had destroyed 127 weapons storage facilities and launch platforms in Yemen's mountainous areas, calling on the Houthis to immediately halt operations targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure. Shortly afterwards, the Houthi military spokesperson said Saudi airspace and airports were unsafe, renewing a warning to airlines while excluding airspace over the holy cities of Mecca and Medina. Saudi Arabia's civil defence authority issued early-warning alerts throughout Thursday over potential threats in the cities of Najran and Jizan, as well as the wider Najran and Jazan regions, before later saying the danger had passed. The Saudi-led coalition said on Thursday that it had intercepted and destroyed a drone in the southwestern Saudi Arabian city of Khamis Mushait, and another launched towards the country's southern region.

item.title: Hurricane Trudy looms over Mexico's Pacific coast, severe rainfall expected
item.description: Hurricane Trudy moved parallel to Mexico's western coast on Thursday, threatening further rain and strong winds in a region already battered in recent weeks by storms that left behind several deaths and severe flooding.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hurricane Trudy moved parallel to Mexico's western coast on Thursday, threatening further rain and strong winds in a region already battered in recent weeks by storms that left behind several deaths and severe flooding. The storm, located about 480 km (298 miles) south-southwest of beach town Acapulco, packed maximum sustained winds of 120 kph (75 mph) and is moving northwest, the US-based National Hurricane Center said in a morning advisory. • Trudy, a Category 1 hurricane, is forecast to rapidly intensify into a major hurricane on Friday. • The storm is then expected to approach Mexico's Pacific coast with heavy rains forecast in the states of Colima and Jalisco, increasing the risk of life-threatening flooding and landslides, the NHC and Mexican authorities warned. • Meanwhile, Tropical Storm Simon is nearly stationary farther northwest offshore, after [USN:L1N45Y0H6 TEXT:"dropping heavy rain"] along the coast earlier as a hurricane. • Simon is forecast to move northwest, grazing the Baja California peninsula over the weekend, the NHC added.

item.title: ＩＥＡ加盟国、石油備蓄の放出加速で合意 軽油2000万バレル超含め
item.description:
Forrest Crellin
[パリ／ロンドン／マドリード １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Forrest Crellin

[パリ／ロンドン／マドリード　１５日　ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）は１５日、ディーゼル燃料（軽油）２０００万バレル超を含め、３月に約束した過去最大規模の緊急備蓄放出の未実施分を市場に供給することで合意した。供給を増やし、高騰する価格の抑制を目指す。

３２カ国が加盟するＩＥＡは１５日に理事会を開き、備蓄放出の規模と時期を協議した。

ＩＥＡは会合後の声明で「理事会はホルムズ海峡危機に対応する２０２６年３月の協調行動を引き続き遂行する方針を再確認した」と表明した。

加盟国は３月、価格高騰を受け、原油と石油製品を合わせて４億バレル超の放出を約束していた。

１５日の会合で加盟国は「可能な限り早期にディーゼル２０００万バレル超を含む残りの放出を加速することで合意した。具体的な計画は既に策定済みだ」とした。

ロイターは今月、欧州連合（ＥＵ）各国政府が、ＩＥＡ加盟国によるディーゼル燃料５０００万バレルと原油５０００万バレルの放出を求めるフランスの提案を協議していると報じた。

スパルタ・コモディティーズのアナリスト、アビシェク・クマール氏は「ＩＥＡの発表は正しい方向への一歩だが、市場が求めていた詳細が不足している」と指摘。「２０００万バレル超のディーゼル燃料は、真の追加放出というより、既存の約束の履行を前倒しするものに見える」と述べた。

ＩＥＡによると、一部の加盟国は既に３月の約束を上回る量を放出しており、他の加盟国も同様の対応を計画している。

加盟国がこれまでに放出した量は約３億３０００万バレルという。

米エネルギー省は、ＩＥＡの声明を引用し、ディーゼル燃料を中心としたさらなる放出が検討され、進められていると説明した。

ただ、同省の報道官は、トランプ政権は「世界のエネルギー市場の供給混乱を最小限に抑え、エネルギー価格の引き下げを支援するという従来の約束を履行していない欧州諸国に対し、引き続き責任を問う」と述べた。

ホワイトハウスは、ＩＥＡの備蓄放出の約束に不満があるかとの質問に対し、１５日のＩＥＡ声明を提示した。

スペインは１５日、１０月中に戦略備蓄から４４０万バレルを放出すると発表した。同国は３月に約束した１１５０万バレルのうち、これまでに３７０万バレルを放出している。

就職フェアの会場に置かれた求人応募用紙。2021年5月、米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

[ワシントン　１５日　ロイター] - 米労働省が１５日発表した１０月１０日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比１０００件増の１９万９０００件となった。小幅な増加にとどまり、一時解雇（レイオフ）が低水準で推移する中、労働市場の安定は維持されている。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万件だった。

１０月３日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は４０００件減の１７１万件となった。ただ、継続受給件数には、大学を最近卒業した人や、職歴が浅い、または全くないために受給資格がない人は含まれていない。

item.title: ＷＥＦ、ラガルド氏を次期会長に指名か 11月2日にも＝関係筋
item.description:
Dave Graham Francesco Canepa
[チューリヒ／バンコク １５日 ロイター] - 世界経済フォ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＷＥＦ、ラガルド氏を次期会長に指名か　11月2日にも＝関係筋 10/15 23:05 配信

2026年10月14日撮影　REUTERS/Athit Perawongmeth

Dave Graham　Francesco Canepa

[チューリヒ／バンコク １５日 ロイター] - 世界経済フォーラム（ＷＥＦ）が来月にも欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁を次期会長に指名する可能性があることが分かった。同組織の関係筋４人がロイターに明らかにした。実現すればラガルド氏はＥＣＢ総裁を任期前に退任することになり、ＥＣＢ首脳部の広範な人事刷新につながる。

関係筋によると、ＷＥＦの理事会は１１月２日に開催され、ラガルド氏自身も参加する。この会合でラガルド氏を次期会長に選出する可能性がある。ただ、最終決定にはまだ至っていないという。

また、理事会は代わりに、来年１月のダボス年次総会でラガルド氏の次期会長選出のための投票日を設定することもあり得るという。

ラガルド氏のＥＣＢ総裁任期は２０２７年１０月まで。早期退任となれば、ＥＣＢの他２つの要職を含む人事を巡る複雑な政治的駆け引きが始まる見通し。

関係筋は、ラガルド氏の選出は確実ではないとしながらも、ラガルド氏は理事会で幅広い支持を得ていると述べた。

ＥＣＢはコメントを差し控えた。

ラガルド氏は、来年までＥＣＢにとどまると述べてきたが、１０月の任期満了まで正式に職務を続けると明言するには至っていない。

item.title: Nvidia, Apple each gave $25 million for Trump's ballroom, Washington Post reports
item.description: Nvidia and Apple each committed $25 million for US President Donald Trump's planned White House ballroom, according to a Washington Post report on Thursday that showed $333 million in private donations for the project.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nvidia (NVDA.O) and Apple (AAPL.O) each committed $25 million for US President Donald Trump's planned White House ballroom, according to a Washington Post report on Thursday that showed $333 million in private donations for the project. The Adelson family, longtime financial supporters of Trump and his Republican Party, committed $25 million as well, as did billionaire Charles Ergen, co-founder and chairman of telecommunications company Dish Network, the report added. The president himself is not on the list, according to the Post. Reuters has not verified the report. The White House said it would not release information about the donors, who spokesman Davis Ingle said "represent a wide array of great American companies." "The same critics who are alleging fake conflicts of interests would also complain if American taxpayers were footing the bill for these long-overdue renovations," Ingle told Reuters. Nvidia said it was proud to make a donation to a nonpartisan trust that serves Americans. "As an American company, our support for the United States is paramount, and independent of any business interests," a spokesperson said. Apple declined to comment. The scale of the ballroom project and the administration’s handling of fundraising and disclosures have drawn criticism from watchdog groups and legal experts, who say they raise questions about transparency, donor influence and adherence to longstanding ethics and oversight norms. "The secrecy is a huge problem," said Eric Petry of the Brennan Center for Justice. "When people with business before the government can give millions to the president's pet project, and the public can't see who or how much, there's no way to tell whether they're buying access or favors." Federal contractors including Lockheed Martin Corp, Microsoft Corp and Palantir Technologies Inc all gave $10 million, the Post reported. The companies did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Trump initially said he and wealthy donors would pay for the estimated $400 million project, but he later unsuccessfully sought $1 billion from Congress for an underground bunker and security features to harden the facility. The Post reported that the "vast majority of the funds raised came from companies and wealthy individuals with interests before the federal government" and that half the total came from companies or executives of firms that have had federal government contracts in Trump's second White House term. The planned ballroom is among [USN:L1N3YZ1G0 TEXT:"several projects"] Trump is pursuing in his efforts to remake Washington with sweeping, unilateral changes that his opponents have challenged in court and called a power grab. The US Supreme Court, in a 5-4 [USN:S0N42U037 TEXT:"ruling"] in August, allowed Trump to continue construction of the ballroom while he challenges a judicial order that would halt much of the development. In a dissent, Chief Justice John Roberts said the project was "likely unlawful." The ballroom, which Trump has said will seat 1,000 guests, has faced public backlash. Preservationists and opponents say Trump exceeded his authority by demolishing the historic East Wing, which housed the first lady's offices and the White House movie theater, to make room for the structure. Trump says a planned 90,000-square-foot (8,360-square-meter) White House ballroom will include bomb shelters, medical facilities, defenses against drones and missiles and other security features. Confronted with criticism of the project, his administration now says the facility is needed for national security, an argument the president has also made about a proposed triumphal arch.

item.title: アンソロピックに上場延期要請、ＮＹ市会計監査官
item.description: [１５日 ロイター] - ニューヨーク市のマーク・レビン会計監査官が、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックに米国で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピックに上場延期要請、ＮＹ市会計監査官 10/15 23:03 配信

2024年5月20日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

[１５日 ロイター] - ニューヨーク市のマーク・レビン会計監査官が、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックに米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を延期すべきとの考えを伝えたことが分かった。安全性や企業統治、開発ペースに関する懸念に対処することが必要だとした。ロイターが１５日、同社のダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に宛てた書簡を入手した。

ＡＩを巡っては、安全性やサイバーセキュリティー上の脅威、悪用など、潜在的なリスクへの監視が強まっている。

書簡でレビン氏は「同社はＩＰＯに向けて突き進むのではなく、こうした前例のないリスクへの対処に力を注ぐべきだ」と記している。

市会計監査官室によると、市の公的年金基金はプライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）投資を通じ、アンソロピックに合計７００万ドルの投資エクスポージャーを持つ。

ニューヨーク市の会計監査官は市の財政を監督し、年金基金を管理するとともに、公的支出や財務慣行を監視する役割を担う。基金の資産総額は３２５０億ドルを超える。

item.title: 米9月ＰＰＩ、前年比6.3％上昇 22年12月以来の大きな伸び
item.description: [ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１５日発表した９月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ、最終需要向け財・サービス）は前...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米9月ＰＰＩ、前年比6.3％上昇　22年12月以来の大きな伸び 10/15 22:52 配信

米ペンシルベニア州フィラデルフィアのガソリンスタンド。5月撮影。REUTERS/Seth Herald

[ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - 米労働省が１５日発表した９月の卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ、最終需要向け財・サービス）は前年比６．３％上昇し、２０２２年１２月以来の大幅な伸びとなった。前月比では１．３％上昇し、２２年３月以来、４年半ぶりの大きな伸びを記録した。財（モノ）・サービスの両面でコスト上昇が進んでおり、エネルギー関連以外にもインフレが広がっていることが改めて示された。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は前月比０．５％上昇だった。８月は当初の０．４％上昇から０．５％上昇に上方改定された。

前日には消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）で幅広い品目が上昇したことが示されており、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が月内の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げに踏み切る可能性が改めて意識された。

オックスフォード・エコノミクスの米国担当シニアエコノミスト、マシュー・マーティン氏は「インフレの定着と底堅い労働市場を踏まえ、ＦＲＢは市場の予想より早く動く必要があると確信しているため、月内のＦＯＭＣで利上げに踏み切ると予想する」と述べた。

フィフス・サード・ウェルス・アドバイザーズの最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）、クリス・オズモンド氏は、経済指標でインフレ加速、消費者支出の鈍化、労働市場の停滞が示されたことに言及し、「厳しい経済環境が交錯していることが改めて明らかになった」と指摘。「ＦＲＢにとってますます困難な組み合わせになっている。政策金利の据え置きを正当化することはできるが、インフレが鈍化しなければ、様子見姿勢をとるコストは高まる」と述べた。

＜モノ価格、エネルギー主導で急伸＞

９月のモノの価格は２．６％上昇し、政府が０９年１２月に同統計の集計を開始して以来の大きな伸びとなった。エネルギー価格が１０．８％上昇し、幅広いモノの価格の上昇分の８０％以上を占めた。

ガソリン価格は２０．３％上昇したほか、ディーゼル燃料（軽油）、ジェット燃料、家庭用電力の価格も上昇した。食品価格は３カ月連続の下落から反転し、１．２％上昇した。食品の大半はトラックで輸送されており、９月の急伸は過去最高水準にあるディーゼル燃料価格が経済全般に波及し始めている初期の兆候である可能性がある。

オックスフォード・エコノミクスの米国担当チーフエコノミスト、マイケル・ピアース氏は「今は財政政策による下支え効果がないため、ガソリン価格の上昇で家計が打撃を受け始めている」と指摘。「ディーゼル価格の上昇は、向こう数カ月で広範な財やサービスの一段の値上げにつながるとみている」と述べた。

変動が激しい食品とエネルギーを除くモノのコア指数は０．３％上昇。８月は０．４％上昇していた。

サービス価格は０．８％上昇。８月は０．２％上昇だった。卸売業者と小売業者が受け取るマージンが１．４％上昇したことが、サービス業全般の上昇の半分近くを占めた。

トラックによる貨物輸送、ホテル・モーテルなどの宿泊料金、航空運賃も上昇した。一方、自動車燃料・潤滑油の小売マージンは３０．３％急落。証券仲介の価格も下落した。

エコノミストは９月の米個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格のコア指数が、前月比０．３５％上昇し、四捨五入ベースで０．４％に達する可能性があると試算。前年同月比では３．１％上昇との見通しを示した。８月のコアＰＣＥインフレ率は前月比０．２％、前年同月比３．０％上昇だった。

item.title: Huracán Trudy se intensifica frente a costa del Pacífico mexicano
item.description: El huracán Trudy se intensificaba rápidamente sobre el océano Pacífico, a medida que se acercaba a la costa occidental de México, amenazando con dejar más lluvias y fuertes vientos en una zona castigada en las últimas semanas por varios ciclones tropicales que han causado inundaciones y algunos muertos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El huracán Trudy se intensificaba rápidamente sobre el océano Pacífico, a medida que se acercaba a la costa occidental de México, amenazando con dejar más lluvias y fuertes vientos en una zona castigada en las últimas semanas por varios ciclones tropicales que han causado inundaciones y algunos muertos. A las 11.00 hora local (1700 GMT), el ciclón se ubicaba a unos 430 kilómetros al sur-suroeste del puerto Acapulco, en el estado Guerrero, y soplaba vientos máximos sostenidos de 150 kilómetros por hora (km/h), con ráfagas más fuertes, mientras avanzaba hacia el norte-noroeste a 9 km/h, según datos del Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos (NHC, por su sigla en inglés). Se espera que Trudy se siga intensificando hasta convertirse en un huracán de categoría 4 en la escala de Saffir-Simpson. Un ciclón de ese nivel puede soplar vientos máximos sostenidos de hasta 250 km/h y causar daños generalizados en estructuras protectoras, desplome de tejados en edificios pequeños, erosión de bancales y playas e inundaciones en terrenos interiores. "Si Trudy se intensifica como se pronostica, los fuertes vientos cerca de su centro generarán olas peligrosamente altas en alta mar. El oleaje se extenderá hacia afuera, amenazando tanto a embarcaciones pequeñas como a grandes buques", advirtió AccuWeather, una compañía estadounidense de servicios comerciales de pronóstico del tiempo. Si bien no se prevé que Trudy toque tierra, descargaría fuertes lluvias en la franja costera que va desde el conocido destino turístico Acapulco hasta Puerto Vallarta, pasando por los dos mayores puertos del país; Lázaro Cárdenas y Manzanillo. En las últimas semanas, la misma zona ya fue golpeada por los huracanes [USN:L6N45L0YK TEXT:"Polo"] y [USN:L8N45V0SM TEXT:"Simón"]. Si bien este último tampoco tocó tierra, sigue activo, aunque como tormenta tropical, frente a la costa del Pacífico mexicano.

item.title: 米9月小売売上高0.8％増、ガソリン高で予想上回る伸び コアは減速
item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン １５日 ロイター] - 米商務省が１５日発表した９月の小売売上高（季節調整...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米9月小売売上高0.8％増、ガソリン高で予想上回る伸び　コアは減速 10/15 22:45 配信

２０２５年１１月、米ワシントン州で撮影　REUTERS/David Ryder

Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン　１５日　ロイター] - 米商務省が１５日発表した９月の小売売上高（季節調整済）は前月比０．８％増加した。ガソリン価格の上昇を背景に予想を上回る伸びとなった。ただ、ガソリン以外の支出は総じて緩やかで、個人消費が力強く拡大した前四半期の勢いが今後も続くとのエコノミストの見方に水を差す可能性がある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は０．３％増。予想レンジは横ばいから０．７％増まで幅があった。

９月の小売売上高の増加分の大半はガソリン価格の上昇によるものだった。米エネルギー情報局（ＥＩＡ）によると、９月のガソリン価格は７．１％上昇した。

９月の自動車、ガソリン、建設資材、外食サービスを除くコア小売売上高は前月比０．１％増。伸びは８月の１．２％から減速したほか、エコノミスト予想の０．３％を下回った。

ガソリンスタンドの売上高は６．４％急増。自動車販売店の売上高は０．２％増だった。家具、電化製品、オンライン小売店の売上高も増加した。

唯一のサービス部門である飲食店の売上高は１．１％増と、８月の１．４％増から鈍化した。建材・園芸用品、スポーツ用品・趣味・楽器・書籍店の売上高は減少した。その他小売店の売上高は３．０％減だった。

８月の小売売上高は１．３％増に上方改定された。国勢調査局は先月、過去の統計修正や新たに利用可能となった調査データを反映させるため、小売売上高の推計値を改定。８月は当初１．２％増と報告されたが、その後１．１％増に下方修正されていた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 最終更新: 10/16(金) 0:57 ロイター

item.title: ウクライナがロ製油所攻撃再開、深まる米との亀裂 プーチン氏報復表明
item.description:
Daniel Flynn Max Hunder
[キーウ １５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Daniel Flynn　Max Hunder

[キーウ １５日 ロイター] - ウクライナは１５日、ロシアの製油所を攻撃した。これに先立ち、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、トランプ米大統領が発表したエネルギー施設への攻撃停止について、ロシアが順守していないとして、ウクライナも応じるのは「終わりだ」と表明した。

トランプ氏が１１日、ロシアとウクライナがエネルギー施設への攻撃停止に合意したと突然発表して以降、ウクライナはロシアの製油所への攻撃を停止していた。しかし、その後もロシアは発電所などのエネルギー施設を含め、ミサイルやドローン（無人機）による攻撃を繰り返し、死者が出たほか、数十万人への電力供給が途絶えた。

ゼレンスキー氏は１５日付の英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）に掲載されたインタビューで、ウクライナの忍耐は限界に達したと表明。「（製油所攻撃の）停止はもうやめる。終わりだ」と述べた。

また、スペースＸの衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の軍用版端末の機能が今週変更され、ウクライナがドローン運用能力が制限されたことについて、「技術的な問題ではなく意図的」とし、政策上の決定だったとの見方を明確にした。

スペースＸを率いるイーロン・マスク氏は「速度や利用の制限は全て、米軍と、最終的にはＰＯＴＵＳ（トランプ氏）が決めている」とＸに投稿した。

ゼレンスキー氏は、製油所への攻撃停止を求めるトランプ氏の要求を事実上拒否することで、２０２２年２月のロシアによるウクライナ侵攻開始以来、米国との間に生じている最大の亀裂を一段と深める恐れがある。

トランプ氏は攻撃停止をロシアとウクライナ双方に求めていると説明してきたが、公の発言では主にウクライナによるロシア製油所への攻撃に焦点を当てている。トランプ氏は、こうした攻撃が世界市場での軽油価格上昇を招いていると批判している。

ウクライナでは、米国が提供する技術になお依存する軍の戦闘に、この亀裂が深刻な影響を及ぼしかねないとの懸念が広がっている。ウクライナ当局者らはここ数日、ロシアのミサイル飛来について、西側同盟国から通常受けている警報が届いていないと報告している。警報は米国の衛星による探知に依存している。

トランプ氏は情報提供を差し控えていることを否定。ゼレンスキー氏によると、警報が提供されなかった理由について、ウクライナ側には技術的な不具合と説明された。

ウクライナ国防省の関係者は１５日、スターリンクの軍用端末は移動中でも機能するようになったが、時速１００マイル（１６０キロ）以下に限られると述べた。ウクライナ当局者らは、中距離攻撃やロシアからのドローン防衛のための迎撃用ドローンには、この速度では遅すぎるとしている。

英国のストリーティング国防相は、ヘグセス米国防長官と１５日に会談し、ウクライナにおけるスターリンクの復旧を歓迎したと述べた。ただ、中断が発生した理由については踏み込まなかったとした。

米ＦＯＸニュースに対し「トランプ氏にはウクライナ問題に関与してもらう必要がある。彼はこれまでそうしてきたし、戦争を終結させる上で、ウクライナがロシアの侵略を撃退するために必要な武器を確保することと同様に、外交ルートも重要だ」と述べた。

１５日にはロシア中央部リャザン州の製油所が攻撃された。同製油所は国営石油大手ロスネフチが所有し、ロシアの石油精製処理量全体のほぼ５％を占め、首都への燃料供給の一翼を担っている。

地元当局者によると、ウクライナによる大規模なドローン（無人機）攻撃により製油所で火災が発生した。

ロシアのプーチン大統領は、ウクライナによるロシア国内の石油精製施設への攻撃に対し報復すると表明。インタファクス通信が報じた。プーチン氏は、ウクライナによる攻撃で特に重大な被害は出ていないとしている。

ウクライナ当局者は、夜間にロシアの製油所を攻撃したと確認。ロシアが今週、エネルギー施設への攻撃停止に違反し、弾道ミサイルやドローンによる激しい攻撃を行ったことへの対応だと説明した。

ゼレンスキー氏はＦＴとのインタビューで、米政府がロシア政府との商業取引に熱心なことや、トランプ氏がプーチン氏に称賛の念を抱いているように見えることを批判した。

両国の亀裂を受け、欧州各国やウクライナは米国の情報や技術に大きく依存していることへの懸念が高まっている。トランプ政権は既にウクライナへの武器供給を停止しているが、欧州の同盟国がウクライナに代わって米国製兵器を購入し続けることは認めている。

欧州には、スターリンクやロシアのミサイル発射を探知する米国の衛星システムに代わる利用可能なシステムが用意できていない。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、ウクライナ軍当局者は米側から、ロシアのエネルギーインフラへの攻撃を停止しなければ、米政府が情報提供を遮断すると警告されていた。

米政権との関係修復に向けてエネルギー施設への攻撃停止に応じる用意があるかとのＦＴの問いにゼレンスキー氏は、見返りとして米国製地対空ミサイル「パトリオット」の迎撃弾を追加供与される場合に限り同意できると答え、それが受け入れられる「最低限」の条件だとした。

BANGKOK, Oct 15 : Japan told its G20 counterparts that authorities must watch exchange-rate moves with a high sense of urgency, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Thursday. The G20 finance leaders re-confirmed their commitment on currency policy, Katayama told reporters after attending the group's gathering, held on the sidelines of the annual IMF meetings in Bangkok this week. "I told the gathering that we must closely watch financial market developments with a high sense of urgency," Katayama said on Japan's exchange-rate policy. The remarks came as the yen's persistent weakness keeps market players on alert over the chance of another round of intervention by authorities to prop up the currency.

A weak yen has become a source of concern for Japanese policymakers by pushing up the cost of imports, including for fuel, which has spiked due to the Middle East war. Katayama said the G20 finance leaders did not produce a joint communique or a chair's statement during their meeting on Thursday. item.title: CCC Intelligent Solutions agrees to $6.1 billion take-private deal with GTCR, Elliott
item.description: CCC Intelligent Solutions said on Thursday it agreed to be acquired by a consortium of private investment firms led by GTCR and including Elliott Investment Management in a $6.1 billion take-private deal.
item.dc:creator: Milana Vinn
item.content:encoded: CCC Intelligent Solutions (CCC.O) said on Thursday it agreed to be acquired by a consortium of private investment firms led by GTCR and including Elliott Investment Management in a $6.1 billion take-private deal. Shareholders of the Chicago-based company will receive $7.75 in cash for each share held, CCC said. The offer represents a 44% premium to the stock's close on July 9, before [USN:L6N43B182 TEXT:"Reuters reported the company was exploring a sale"]. CCC provides software to the property and casualty insurance industry, including tools for claims management and damage estimation. Software valuations are under pressure amid concerns that artificial intelligence could disrupt businesses, slow growth and erode earnings. Investors have been largely indiscriminate in their selloff of software stocks, creating opportunities for private equity firms to acquire companies they view as undervalued, said Nelson Iginla, a principal at GTCR. "CCC is a business where the stock price was much higher historically ... but as we look at the actual underlying performance of the business, the performance has been extremely strong," Iginla said. "When you peel things back, it's a business that we think is made better by AI, not worse by AI." Earlier this year, the company faced investor concerns over slowing growth, softer claims volumes and a slower-than-expected rollout of some newer software products, which had weighed on its share price. The company said the deal followed a review of strategic options. Private equity firm Advent International acquired CCC in 2017. Advent later took the company public through a merger with a blank-check company in 2021 and exited its investment in 2025. The deal is not subject to financing conditions and is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, after which CCC will become privately held. The company is scheduled to report third-quarter results on October 29. CCC shares were little changed at $7.61 in Thursday trading, after rising recently on media reports of a potential deal. Morgan Stanley is advising CCC, while J.P. Morgan and Citi are advising GTCR. Simpson Thacher & Bartlett served as legal counsel to GTCR, and Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher and Debevoise & Plimpton served as legal counsel to Elliott.
